title_translated: 值得重新考虑：回复长度决定了用户反驳使语言模型变得谄媚还是自我修正
summary_translated: 语言模型在用户无理由反驳时常常放弃正确答案，这种行为通常被视为需抑制的谄媚倾向。然而，同样的反驳也可能促使模型重新审视并修复错误答案。我们通过四个开放模型（来自两个系列：Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B 和 OLMo-2 7B）在MMLU和ARC-Challenge多选题数据集上测量这两种效应，从自由回复后的选项logits中精确读取最终答案。回复预算决定了结论：当Qwen3-4B最多只能用96个token回答时，反驳对准确率无影响或略有下降；而当允许1,024个token时，模型能修正43%的错误答案，准确率提升5.7个百分点。整体上，反驳是否有益遵循简单的盈亏平衡规则，取决于退让率与修正率。在模型内部，退让行为可在挑战前部分预测：在三次探测实验中，隐藏状态相比初始置信度额外提供约0.04–0.06 AUROC。仅在自修正案例上训练的探测器能在回复截断时预测退让行为，但在模型可完成推理时则无法做到。激活引导从未能选择性减少退让：一旦有效，它同时抑制了自我修正。我们得出结论，评估谄媚行为应允许完整回复，并同时报告退让与自我修正情况。

summary: Large language models can rapidly extract structured multivariate experimental data from the chemistry literature, yet verifying thousands of generated records without ground truth remains difficult. We present a general, citation-grounded extraction and verification methodology centered on an independent "LLM-as-a-judge", applied to the literature on homogeneous catalytic poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET) depolymerisation. In this pipeline, an extractor LLM generates schema-enforced records from research papers with citations to document chunks tagged with universally unique identifiers (UUIDs); an independent LLM judge then reads the full paper alongside each record, flags unsupported fields, and proposes cited corrections. Prompt ablations show that requiring chunk-level citations not only provides provenance down to specific paragraphs and tables but also improves extraction accuracy. Before deploying the judge at scale, we benchmarked it against manual evaluation on extractions from a hand-curated reference set of 295 ionic-liquid-catalysed PET glycolysis experiments. The judge agreed with human evaluation on 85.7% of reviewed records and was significantly more effective than a heuristic string-matching baseline at catching errors across related experiments. Deployed across 3,942 extracted records from 561 papers, the framework accepted 67.5% of them as written. Its proposed corrections concentrated on quantitative fields, where the extractor often conflated related experiments. We release the extracted dataset with the complete LLM judge audit logs, as well as the Chemistry Data Extractor Toolkit, an open-source application implementing this end-to-end pipeline in a code-free, browser-based environment for document parsing, customizable schema and prompt design, model-agnostic extraction and auditing, interactive provenance-highlighted review, and reproducible dataset bundling.
title: Building and Auditing Chemical Datasets with LLMs: A General LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Applied to Homogeneous Catalytic PET Depolymerisation
title_translated: 利用大语言模型构建与审计化学数据集：一种应用于均相催化PET解聚的通用LLM作为裁判框架
summary_translated: 大语言模型能够快速从化学文献中提取结构化的多变量实验数据，但缺乏真实标签的情况下验证数千条生成记录仍具挑战。我们提出一种通用的、基于引用的提取与验证方法，核心为独立的“LLM作为裁判”框架，应用于均相催化聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）解聚的文献研究。该流程中，提取器LLM从论文中生成符合模式的记录，并附带指向带有唯一标识符（UUID）的文档片段的引用；独立的LLM裁判则阅读完整论文及每条记录，标记无支持的字段并提出引用修正建议。提示工程消融实验表明，要求片段级引用不仅可追溯至具体段落和表格，还能提升提取准确性。在部署裁判前，我们基于295个手工整理的离子液体催化PET甘醇解聚实验参考集进行了人工评估基准测试。裁判与人工评估在85.7%的审查记录上达成一致，且在捕捉相关实验中的错误方面显著优于启发式字符串匹配基线。该框架已部署于561篇论文中提取的3,942条记录，其中67.5%被接受为有效记录。其提出的修正主要集中在定量字段，因提取器常混淆相关实验。我们发布了包含完整LLM裁判审计日志的提取数据集，以及Chemistry Data Extractor Toolkit——一个开源应用程序，可在无需代码的浏览器环境中实现端到端管道，支持文档解析、自定义模式与提示设计、模型无关的提取与审计、交互式溯源高亮审查及可复现的数据集打包。

summary: Large language models rely on a single tokenizer that is chosen at training time and fixed thereafter. Most tokenizers are trained on English-dominant corpora, making them under-serve morphologically rich and non-Latin-script languages, where they can produce fragmented representations, longer sequence lengths, and reduced information density during training. We propose Mixture of Tokenizers MoTo, a modular tokenization framework that trains dedicated per-language BPE tokenizers and composes them into a unified superset vocabulary, where tokens shared across languages are deduplicated into a common ID space. Each tokenizer maintains its own normalization policy, pre-tokenization rules, and vocabulary budget. Despite allocating significantly fewer entries to English, MoTo retains English performance while delivering consistent gains across 18 out of 21 typologically diverse languages spanning six scripts, with improvements most pronounced on morphologically complex and non-Latin-script languages that are systematically underserved by English-dominant tokenizer design. Our results suggest that modular subword tokenization is a practical and extensible alternative to monolithic tokenization for multilingual parity.
title: MoTo: Mixture of Tokenizers Towards Fair Multilingual Language Modeling
comment: Neurips 2026, 40 pages, 21 figures
title_translated: MoTo：通向公平多语言语言建模的分词器混合方案
summary_translated: 大型语言模型依赖于训练时选定且固定不变的单一分词器。大多数分词器基于以英语为主的语料库训练，导致在形态丰富或非拉丁字母语言中表现不佳，常产生碎片化表示、更长序列长度和训练期间信息密度降低。我们提出分词器混合方案MoTo，一种模块化分词框架，为每种语言训练专用的BPE分词器，并将其组合成统一的超集词汇表，跨语言共享的token在公共ID空间中去重。每个分词器保持独立的归一化策略、预分词规则和词汇预算。尽管分配给英语的条目显著减少，MoTo仍保持英语性能，同时在21种语言中18种类型多样语言（涵盖六种书写系统）上实现稳定提升，尤其在形态复杂且非拉丁字母语言上改进最为明显，这些语言在以英语为主导的分词器设计下长期被系统性忽视。结果表明，模块化子词分词是实现多语言平等性的实用且可扩展的替代方案。

summary: General-purpose chatbots are increasingly used for emotional and mental health support. They can be useful, but issues such as sycophancy, reinforcement of delusional beliefs, and poor crisis response create risks that are difficult for researchers to study and evaluate. In this paper, we review the most critical open problems for researchers and policymakers in the use of general-purpose chatbots and their effects on mental health. First, there are tractable problems in the controlled evaluation of chatbots: establishing the construct and ecological validity of evaluations, evaluating multi-turn interactions, and connecting evaluations to improvements in chatbot behavior. For example, conventional benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets cannot establish chatbot safety, and novel simulation methods need validation. Second, researchers must connect their studies of chatbots and mental health to real-world evidence. This includes analyzing the chatbot products that AI companies and mental health practitioners have deployed, including their user interfaces and human review and escalation practices for user welfare concerns. However, clinical analysis opportunities afforded by real chat log data sharing are complicated by significant privacy concerns. Finally, we argue that researchers should take an active role in the construction and refinement of evidence-based policy through corporate and governmental decisions such as user protections, standards of care, protected access to user chat logs, data sharing between institutions, incident reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. Such behavioral evaluations, studies of real-world outcomes, and data governance depend on each other and must be addressed in tandem. We believe a coordinated research effort would have substantial real-world impact.
title: Open Problems in Chatbots and Mental Health
title_translated: 聊天机器人与心理健康领域的开放问题
summary_translated: 通用型聊天机器人正越来越多地用于情感与心理健康支持。它们虽具实用性，但诸如阿谀奉承、强化妄想信念及应对危机能力差等问题带来了难以研究与评估的风险。本文综述了研究人员与政策制定者在使用通用聊天机器人及其对心理健康影响方面的关键开放问题。首先，在受控评估方面存在可解决的问题：建立评估的构念效度与生态效度，评估多轮交互，将评估结果与聊天机器人行为改进关联起来。例如，仅依赖静态数据集的传统基准无法验证聊天机器人安全性，而新型模拟方法需进一步验证。其次，研究人员必须将其关于聊天机器人与心理健康的研究所获成果与现实世界证据相连接。这包括分析AI公司与心理健康从业者已部署的聊天机器人产品，如用户界面设计、人类审核与紧急情况升级机制等用户福祉保障措施。然而，真实聊天日志数据共享带来的临床分析机会受到重大隐私担忧的制约。最后，我们主张研究人员应积极参与基于证据的政策构建与完善，通过企业与政府决策（如用户保护、护理标准、受保护的用户聊天日志访问权、机构间数据共享、事件报告及部署后监控）推动发展。此类行为评估、真实世界效果研究与数据治理相互依赖，必须协同推进。我们认为，协调一致的研究努力将产生显著的现实影响。

summary: Agents built on reasoning models resend their growing transcript at every call. Two transacting parties, not the model, decide what that costs: the client keeps or edits messages; the server decides whether earlier reasoning returns in the prompt and what its cache reuses. We define a cost model whose counts match an instrumented engine exactly; the architecture charges $c$ per token processed and $β$ per pair attended. Their ratio $P^*=c/β$ is an exchange rate between thinking and remembering: per token, processing dominates below this context length, a thinking regime, and attention above it, a memory regime. A policy change has a mechanical cost, incurred even if the agent writes the same tokens, and a behavioral one: it writes different tokens, changing cost and outcome. Serving alone can flip which policy is cheaper: on recorded Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld runs, dropping earlier reasoning costs 1.74 times keeping it when the server reuses generated states and 0.34 times when it reuses nothing. In live reruns, dropping it cuts correct HotpotQA answers by 9-23 percentage points on four models, at lower point-estimate cost. Comparing context policies means comparing systems: architecture and serving set the cost of the history kept and the work it induces.
title: Think or Remember: The Exchange Rate of Agentic Inference
title_translated: 思考还是记忆：智能体推理中的交换率
summary_translated: 基于推理模型构建的智能体在每次调用时都会重新发送其不断增长的对话记录。决定这一成本的是两个交易方——客户端决定保留或编辑消息；服务器决定是否将早期推理结果纳入提示，并决定其缓存重用策略。我们定义了一个成本模型，其计数与仪器化引擎完全匹配；架构按每处理一个token收费c，按每对注意力对收费β。它们的比值P*=c/β构成思考与记忆之间的交换率：在该上下文长度以下，每token处理占主导，处于思考模式；以上则注意力占优，进入记忆模式。策略变更具有机械成本，即使智能体写出相同token也会产生；还有行为成本：它写出不同token，从而改变成本与结果。仅服务端设置即可改变哪种策略更便宜：在记录的Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld运行中，若服务器重用生成状态，删除早期推理的成本是保留它的1.74倍；若不重用，则仅为0.34倍。在实时重运行中，删除早期推理使四个模型在HotpotQA任务上的正确答案下降9-23个百分点，但点估计成本更低。比较上下文策略即是在比较系统：架构与服务设置决定了所保留历史的成本及其引发的工作量。

summary: Reasoning in large language models can be disrupted by simple input perturbations (e.g. adding irrelevant distractors), suggesting reliance on spurious correlations. Identifying and suppressing the spurious features involved in long chain-of-thought reasoning remains challenging. We introduce Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing (SWEET), a training-free method that combines counterfactual interventions with mechanistic interpretability to identify and suppress spurious-features. SWEET extracts token- and sequence-level behavioral directions from activation contrasts between original problems and their counterfactual variants - capturing local and global patterns of spurious reasoning. It then localizes the responsible MLP neurons and attention heads and suppresses their contributions along these directions through weight edits. Using only 20 original-counterfactual pairs for direction extraction, SWEET improves accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points on perturbed inputs and 2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five reasoning benchmarks. It also reduces the relative gap between original and perturbed accuracies from 17.6% to 2.5%. Analyses identify two recurring forms of spurious reasoning, i.e. over-integrating irrelevant conditions and overthinking, and provide mechanistic evidence that SWEET improves reasoning robustness by suppressing both behavioral directions.
title: SWEET: Mitigating Spurious Feature Reliance in LLM Reasoning via Weight Editing
title_translated: SWEET：通过权重编辑缓解大语言模型推理中的虚假特征依赖
summary_translated: 大语言模型的推理可能因简单输入扰动（如添加无关干扰项）而中断，表明其依赖于虚假相关性。识别并抑制长链思维推理中涉及的虚假特征仍具挑战。我们提出Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing（SWEET），一种无需训练的方法，结合反事实干预与机制可解释性，以识别并抑制虚假特征。SWEET从原始问题与其反事实变体之间的激活对比中提取token级与序列级的行为方向——捕捉虚假推理的局部与全局模式。随后定位负责的MLP神经元与注意力头，并沿这些方向通过权重编辑抑制其贡献。仅使用20组原始-反事实配对进行方向提取，SWEET在五种开源权重推理模型与五个推理基准上，对扰动输入平均提升准确率11.8个百分点，对原始输入提升2个百分点。同时，原始与扰动准确率之间的相对差距从17.6%降至2.5%。分析揭示两种反复出现的虚假推理形式：过度整合无关条件与过度思考，并提供了机制证据表明SWEET通过抑制这两种行为方向提升了推理鲁棒性。

summary: Safety-aligned large language models often lose their safety behaviors after fine-tuning, even when safety data are included. While this fragility is well documented, its underlying cause remains unclear. In this paper, we propose that formulaic refusal strings can function as outlier modes: narrow, weakly grounded response patterns that are easy to fit but vulnerable to subsequent updates. Controlled experiments support this account: fixed refusals are acquired much like arbitrary constant strings, in contrast to prompt-grounded natural responses. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Naturalness-Enhanced Safety Targets (NEST), a safety alignment framework that improves safety retention by constructing natural, context-aware safety targets that keep safety responses within the model's existing output distribution and grounded in semantics. We instantiate NEST in both supervised and preference-based alignment settings, using perplexity under the original model as a proxy for distributional support. Across multiple models and alignment regimes, natural safety targets improve both immediate safety and its retention under continued fine-tuning without sacrificing helpfulness. These findings suggest a practical principle for more durable safety alignment: construct safety targets that draw on the model's existing language capabilities and remain grounded in the meaning of each request.
title: When Safety Becomes An Outlier: Understanding the Retention of LLM Safety Behaviors
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 当安全行为变成异常值：理解大语言模型安全行为的保留机制
summary_translated: 对齐安全的大语言模型在微调后常常会丧失其安全行为，即使包含了安全数据也是如此。尽管这种脆弱性已被广泛记录，但其根本原因仍不明确。本文提出，公式化的拒绝字符串可能作为异常值模式存在：即狭窄且弱基础的响应模式，易于拟合但容易受到后续更新的影响。受控实验支持这一观点：固定拒绝响应的习得方式与任意常量字符串类似，而非基于提示的自然响应。基于这些发现，我们提出了自然性增强的安全目标（NEST）框架，通过构建自然、上下文感知的安全目标来提升安全行为的保留能力，使安全响应保持在模型现有的输出分布内并基于语义。我们在监督和基于偏好对齐设置中实现了NEST，使用原始模型下的困惑度作为分布支持的代理。在多个模型和对齐范式中，自然安全目标在不牺牲有用性的前提下，提升了即时安全性和持续微调下的安全保留能力。这些发现表明了一条实用原则：构建安全目标时应利用模型已有的语言能力，并保持对每个请求语义的根基。

summary: The field of mechanistic interpretability is well-suited to collaborative projects between mathematicians and AI researchers. This work describes one such project. We trained a small transformer to learn the language of the Coxeter group affine A2, best known as the symmetries of the tiling of the Euclidean plane by equilateral triangles. We then formulated and proved a word-theoretic conjecture about affine A2 after observing the attention patterns of the trained model.
title: Can small transformers learn the language of Coxeter groups?
comment: 13 pages, 13 figures, accepted as a poster at the 6th workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI; NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta; This version is updated from the camera-ready version which can be found at this https URL and this https URL
title_translated: 小型Transformer能否学习Coxeter群的语言？
summary_translated: 机械可解释性领域非常适合数学家与人工智能研究人员之间的合作项目。本研究描述了这样一个项目。我们训练了一个小型Transformer模型来学习仿射A2 Coxeter群的语言，该群最著名的是欧几里得平面上等边三角形铺砌的对称性。在观察训练后模型的注意力模式后，我们提出了一个关于仿射A2的词论猜想，并成功证明了它。

summary: Researchers increasingly estimate political behavior based on race and gender from voter files, where race is imputed from surnames and geography. This only works where surnames suggest group membership, an assumption violated where surnames follow norms around marriage. Imputation is therefore biased against women who adopt their husband's surname, especially those who racially inter-marry, an outcome itself endogenous to partisanship. Using six US states recording self-reported race, I show that imputation is less accurate for Asian and Hispanic women, particularly those sharing the surname of a partner of another race, who differ politically from other women of their race. This violates assumptions behind downstream inference approaches, which nearly double the gender gap in partisanship among Asian voters. I derive an expression showing the bias is largest where a group is small. Using maiden rather than marriage-adopted surnames in North Carolina raises accuracy up to fourfold for women married across racial lines. Recovering maiden surnames, or omitting the married surname, removes much of the bias. In a national replication of a study of gender gaps in turnout, the correction more than triples the gap among Asian voters. In Lebanon, where wives register in their husband's locality, the error enters through geography.
title: Gendered Misclassification from Surname-Based Race Imputation
title_translated: 基于姓氏的种族推断导致的性别误分类
summary_translated: 研究人员越来越多地根据选民档案中的姓氏和地理信息来推断政治行为中的种族和性别。这种方法仅在姓氏能反映群体归属时才有效，但在姓氏遵循婚姻规范的情况下这一假设被破坏。因此，采用丈夫姓氏的女性，尤其是跨种族婚姻的女性，面临系统性偏差。利用六个记录自报种族的美国州的数据，我发现基于姓氏的推断对亚裔和西班牙裔女性的准确性较低，特别是那些与另一种族伴侣共用姓氏的女性，其政治立场与其他同族女性不同。这违反了下游推断方法的基本假设，几乎使亚裔选民中的党派性别差距翻倍。我推导出一个表达式，表明偏差在群体规模较小时最大。在北卡罗来纳州使用 maiden surname（婚前姓）而非婚后姓氏，可使跨种族婚姻女性的推断准确率提高至四倍。恢复婚前姓氏或忽略婚后姓氏可显著减少偏差。在全国范围内复制一项关于投票性别差距的研究时，修正后亚裔选民的差距扩大超过三倍。在黎巴嫩，妻子注册在丈夫所在地，误差则通过地理信息进入。

summary: Existing evaluations of AI models on high-finance work focus on retrieving answers from financial documents and producing numerically correct outputs. Real private equity (PE) and investment banking (IB) work also depends on choosing between conflicting sources, making sound assumptions, and keeping every step auditable. We introduce DeepFinance, an ultra long-horizon benchmark of 21 end-to-end PE and IB tasks that take a human professional an average of 27.1 hours. Each task pairs a request with a data room averaging 19 files and is graded against an average of 84 expert-written rubric criteria covering output, workflow, and judgment. We evaluate 22 model configurations, each in its native agent harness. The best configuration, GPT-6 Astra with max reasoning, satisfies 57.6% of rubric criteria, and the top four configurations are not statistically distinguishable. Frontier models often calculate correctly from the wrong inputs and find decision-relevant evidence without acting on it.
title: DeepFinance: Can AI Diligence a $100MM Deal?
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Leaderboard: this https URL
title_translated: DeepFinance：AI能否胜任一亿美元交易的尽职调查？
summary_translated: 现有对AI模型在高金融任务中的评估主要集中在从金融文档中检索答案和生成数值正确的输出。然而，真实的私募股权（PE）和投资银行（IB）工作还依赖于在冲突信息源之间做出选择、做出合理假设以及确保每一步可审计。我们引入了DeepFinance，这是一个超长时序基准，包含21个端到端的PE和IB任务，平均需要人类专业人士耗时27.1小时完成。每个任务配对一个请求与平均19份文件的数据室，并依据平均84项专家撰写的评分标准（涵盖输出、工作流程和判断）进行评分。我们评估了22种模型配置，每种均在其原生智能体框架中运行。表现最佳的配置GPT-6 Astra（最大推理）满足了57.6%的评分标准，而排名前四的配置在统计上无法区分。前沿模型经常基于错误输入正确计算，却未能采取行动处理决定性证据。

summary: In Bangla, a main verb is often followed by one of a small set of vector verbs. These verbs lose their own meaning and add a shade of meaning instead, such as completion. For example, likhe phello means that someone finished writing, not that they wrote and threw something. The same two verbs can also describe two separate events, so only the context shows which meaning is meant. This makes compound verbs a hard test of how language models handle multiword expressions. We present BanglaCV-Probe, a benchmark of 17 vector verbs with 1,044 minimal pairs, 204 entailment items and 197 pairs of correct and incorrect combinations, all checked by native speakers. We test 26 models (encoders, LLMs and translation systems) on four skills: telling the two meanings apart internally, understanding what a vector adds, preferring correct combinations and keeping the vector's meaning in translation. Probes on five encoders tell the two meanings apart and still reach up to 93% accuracy when trained on pairs without surface cues. Prompted models rarely use this knowledge. Entailment accuracy stays between 59% and 81%. Several LLMs answer Yes or No to almost every item, and nine of ten models miss that someone who ate up the rice left none. Most instruction-tuned LLMs translate vectors literally in 15-20% of vector sentences and in up to 55% for mora (die). On correct combinations, a small Bangla-only model (88%) matches BLOOM-7B1 (87%) and both beat Qwen2.5-7B (74%). Data and code: https://github.com/ashuvo25/Pole_OR_Vector
title: Pole or Vector? Encoders Capture Bangla Compound Verbs, but LLMs Read Them Literally
title_translated: 是极点还是向量？编码器捕捉孟加拉复合动词，而大语言模型将其字面理解
summary_translated: 在孟加拉语中，主谓词后常接一组少量的向量动词。这些动词失去自身意义，转而添加一种语义色彩，如完成。例如，likhe phello意为“某人完成了写作”，而非“他们写了并扔了东西”。同样的两个动词也可描述两个独立事件，因此只有上下文才能决定具体含义。这使得复合动词成为检验语言模型处理多词表达能力的难题。我们提出了BanglaCV-Probe，一个包含17个向量动词的基准测试，包含1,044组最小对立对、204个蕴含项和197组正确与错误组合，所有内容均由母语者验证。我们测试了26个模型（编码器、LLMs和翻译系统）在四项技能上的表现：内部区分两种含义、理解向量所添加的意义、偏好正确组合以及在翻译中保持向量意义。对五个编码器的探测显示，它们能区分两种含义，在无表面线索的配对训练下准确率高达93%。而提示型模型很少使用这一知识。蕴含准确率介于59%至81%之间。多个LLM对几乎所有项目回答Yes或No，且十个中有九个未意识到吃完米饭的人已无剩余。大多数指令微调的LLM在15%-20%的向量句中字面翻译向量，对于mora（死亡）甚至高达55%。在正确组合上，一个小规模的孟加拉语专用模型（88%）与BLOOM-7B1（87%）相当，两者均优于Qwen2.5-7B（74%）。数据与代码：https://github.com/ashuvo25/Pole_OR_Vector

summary: Fixed prompt-based language models face challenges in open-domain conversations, where versatile topics require different expert advice or demonstrations to maximize their universal performance. Motivated by the dynamic prompt studies in language generation, we extract different chatting strategies from varied forms of text corpus, which steer the language model to different styles based on human principles. We design and deploy a conversational companion called SCorPion, which uses GraphRAG to extract and summarize the knowledge graph globally, yield community-summarized strategies, and produce query-focused optimal strategies. SCorPion has strategic thinking, yields personified and stylized responses, and can be controlled by explicit factors. Code and further results can be found in https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/.
title: SCorPion: A Strategic, Controllable and Personified Conversational Companion
comment: NeurIPS 2025 PersonaLLM Workshop
title_translated: SCorPion：一种战略化、可控制且人格化的对话伴侣
summary_translated: 基于提示的固定语言模型在开放域对话中面临挑战，因为多变的主题需要不同的专家建议或示范以最大化其通用性能。受语言生成中动态提示研究的启发，我们从不同形式的文本语料库中提取出多种聊天策略，根据人类原则引导语言模型采用不同风格。我们设计并部署了一种名为SCorPion的对话伴侣，它使用GraphRAG全局提取和总结知识图谱，生成社区汇总策略，并产出针对查询的最优策略。SCorPion具备战略思维，能生成人格化和风格化的回应，并可通过显式因素进行控制。代码与更多结果详见 https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/。

summary: Public automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmarks increasingly report low sequence error rates, yet production systems still use hotword lists, contextual biasing, retrieval, and post-correction. This motivates a complementary question: does a transcript preserve selected names, products, technical terms, versions, and relational phrases? We present KeyASRBench, a bilingual pilot that operationalizes occurrence-based Keyword Error Rate (KER) over frozen whole-phrase annotations. The 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set contains 1,501 Chinese and English clips with 4,723 keyword occurrences. Across five locally inferred checkpoints and two official API systems, language-specific MER/WER ranges from 5.31% to 12.91%, while KER ranges from 13.61% to 33.81%. A disjoint 30-minute model-blind control yields KER of 10.65%-27.31%. The control confirms that selected-phrase errors extend beyond challenge-set selection.
title: KeyASRBench: Measuring Whole-Phrase Keyword Preservation in Real-World ASR
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Bilingual ASR evaluation with a 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set and a disjoint 30-minute model-blind control
title_translated: KeyASRBench：衡量真实世界语音识别中的整词关键词保留率
summary_translated: 公开的自动语音识别（ASR）基准报告的序列错误率不断降低，但实际生产系统仍依赖热词列表、上下文偏置、检索和后纠正。这引出了一个补充性问题：转录文本是否保留了选定的姓名、产品、技术术语、版本及关系短语？我们提出了KeyASRBench，一个双语试点项目，通过冻结的整词标注操作化地定义基于出现次数的关键词错误率（KER）。该10小时的模型条件挑战集包含1501段中英文片段，共4723次关键词出现。在五个本地推断检查点和两个官方API系统中，语言特定的MER/WER范围为5.31%至12.91%，而KER范围为13.61%至33.81%。一个独立的30分钟模型盲控组显示KER为10.65%至27.31%。该对照证实，选定短语错误超出了挑战集选择范围。

summary: In a multi-turn conversation, the choice of language model at one turn can affect which model should answer the next. The selected model's reply shapes the context for the next query, and its cached prompt prefix can reduce the cost of using that model again. We introduce MultiTurnRoute, a platform for building and evaluating multi-turn LLM routers. A shared interface gives built-in and user-defined routers the current query, dialogue history, and an estimate of each model's reusable prefix length. Our routing algorithm, Chain-of-Route (CoR), uses a learned gate over recent and recurrent dialogue history to predict response quality and estimates cost from each model's reusable prefix. MultiTurnRoute Arena ranks routers on recorded conversations and compares session quality and cost in interactive runs where a simulated user responds to each reply. On a benchmark drawn from WildChat and LMSYS-Chat-1M with per-turn quality annotations for five LLMs, CoR reduces the normalized cost required to match the strongest model's quality by up to 20.3% relative to the strongest routing baseline, while matching or improving peak response quality.
title: MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: MultiTurnRoute：构建与评估多轮LLM路由的平台
summary_translated: 在多轮对话中，某一回合的语言模型选择会影响下一回合应由哪个模型回答。所选模型的回复会塑造下一轮查询的上下文，其缓存的提示前缀还能降低再次使用该模型的成本。我们引入MultiTurnRoute，一个用于构建和评估多轮LLM路由的平台。统一接口为内置和用户自定义路由提供当前查询、对话历史以及各模型可重用前缀长度的估计值。我们的路由算法Chain-of-Route（CoR）利用对近期和重复对话历史的学习门控机制，预测响应质量并估算各模型的使用成本。MultiTurnRoute Arena通过记录的对话对路由算法进行排名，并在模拟用户交互运行中比较会话质量和成本。在基于WildChat和LMSYS-Chat-1M的基准数据集上，该数据集对五种LLM每轮质量进行了标注，CoR相比最强的路由基线，在保持最强模型质量的前提下，将所需归一化成本降低了最多20.3%，同时匹配或提升了峰值响应质量。

summary: Plot-to-code generation has been greatly advanced by recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing studies mainly focus on one-pass generation or iterative sampling guided by verifier-based filtering, which does not align with the typical human programming workflow of generate first, then iteratively error-location and fix. This naturally motivates a test-time refinement paradigm for plot-to-code generation. In this work, we present the first study on plot-to-code generation via iterative test-time refinement. We propose a Visual-Code Diagnostics framework that enables refinement through visual feedback from source code. Specifically, we first categorize generation errors into four coarse-grained types, and then train lightweight discriminators to recognize and localize these errors based on the rendered visual outputs and corresponding code. Unlike traditional compiler- or debugger-based verification, our approach performs iterative refinement guided by one diagnostics system, enabling more effective semantic and visual correction during test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves generation quality across diverse generators and significantly outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines.
title: Simple Test-Time Refinement for Plot-to-Code Generation via Visual-Code Diagnostics
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 基于视觉-代码诊断的绘图到代码生成的简单测试时精炼方法
summary_translated: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）极大地推动了绘图到代码生成的发展。然而，现有研究主要集中在单次生成或基于验证器过滤的迭代采样，这与人类编程中先生成再迭代定位和修复错误的典型工作流程不一致。这自然催生了绘图到代码生成的测试时精炼范式。本文首次研究了通过迭代测试时精炼实现的绘图到代码生成。我们提出Visual-Code Diagnostics框架，通过源代码的视觉反馈实现精炼。具体而言，我们首先将生成错误分为四类粗粒度类型，然后训练轻量级判别器，基于渲染的视觉输出和对应代码来识别和定位这些错误。与传统的编译器或调试器验证不同，我们的方法通过单一诊断系统引导迭代精炼，从而在测试时实现更有效的语义和视觉修正。大量实验表明，该方法在多种生成器上持续提升生成质量，并显著优于强测试时扩展基线。

summary: How does Jev compare with other systems on Arabic tasks, and how does its performance change between Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and dialects? We evaluate 67 systems, including 47 decision models and 20 large language models (LLMs), on 43 tasks across 9 task families using a shared zero-shot protocol. The Arabic-focused frozen suite includes English controls in three parallel resources, which we also remove in a separate descriptive comparison. Jev 1.14.0 achieves a mean task-primary metric of 69.24 on a scale multiplied by 100, compared with 68.77 for Jev 1.13.0 and 71.81 for Gemma-4-31B, the highest-scoring system on this aggregate. Removing the recorded English controls, repeated cross-task items or both leaves the full system order unchanged. Relative performance and gains between Jev versions vary across task families. In content-matched comparisons within Jev 1.14.0, pooled dialect-minus-MSA accuracy gaps range from -7.94 to -0.35 percentage points across four datasets; dialect-specific results show larger variation, and SIB-200's source-clustered interval includes zero. Paired contrasts with Jev 1.13.0, Gemma-4-31B and Jais-2-8B show a larger Palestinian banking penalty for Jev 1.14.0 than for either LLM under simultaneous uncertainty; the other gap contrasts remain inconclusive. These descriptive findings show why aggregate scores should be read alongside task-family results, coverage and matched language comparisons. They do not establish a general model ranking for dialect robustness or explain the causes of the observed gaps.
title: Evaluating Jev on Arabic: Comparing Decision Models and LLMs Across Arabic Tasks and Dialects
comment: 28 pages, including references and appendices
title_translated: 评估Jev在阿拉伯语上的表现：跨阿拉伯任务与方言的决策模型与大语言模型对比
summary_translated: Jev在阿拉伯语任务上的表现如何？其在现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）与方言之间的性能变化如何？我们在43个任务、9个任务类别上，使用统一的零样本协议评估了67个系统，包括47个决策模型和20个大语言模型（LLMs）。该聚焦阿拉伯语的冻结套件包含三个平行资源中的英语对照，我们还在单独的描述性比较中移除了这些对照。Jev 1.14.0在乘以100的尺度上取得平均任务主指标69.24，略低于Jev 1.13.0的68.77，但高于最高得分系统Gemma-4-31B的71.81。移除记录的英语对照、重复跨任务项或两者均未改变完整系统排序。Jev版本间的相对表现和增益在不同任务类别中存在差异。在Jev 1.14.0内部的内容匹配比较中，合并后的方言减MSA准确率差距在四个数据集中介于-7.94至-0.35个百分点之间；方言特定结果表现出更大波动，SIB-200的源聚类区间包含零值。与Jev 1.13.0、Gemma-4-31B和Jais-2-8B的成对对比显示，Jev 1.14.0在巴勒斯坦银行业务任务上承受更大的惩罚，且在不确定性同时存在的情况下，这一差距大于两个LLM；其他差距对比则仍不明确。这些描述性发现说明，聚合得分应结合任务类别结果、覆盖范围和匹配语言比较一同解读。它们并未建立方言鲁棒性的通用模型排名，也无法解释观察到差距的原因。

summary: We improve Turkish mathematical reasoning in Large Language Models by combining LoRA fine-tuning, weight-space model merging, and search-based inference. Using Turkish-Llama 8B-DPO with Turkish translations of MetaMath, NuminaMath, and TigerLab, we find data quality beats scale (Mix-30k best among fine-tuned; large MetaMath underperforms). Linear merging delivers the largest gains (GSM8K up to 0.63), while Ties is modest and Breadcrumbs/Slerp degrade. Search with MCTS and Tree of Thoughts improves mean LLM-judge scores for reasoning quality on a 0-100 scale. Limitations include machine translation, limited scale, and search stochasticity.
title: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in Turkish Large Language Models with Search-Based Inference and Model Merging
title_translated: 基于搜索推理与模型融合增强土耳其语大语言模型的数学推理能力
summary_translated: 我们通过结合LoRA微调、权重空间模型融合和基于搜索的推理，提升了大语言模型在土耳其语数学推理方面的能力。使用土耳其语-Llama 8B-DPO及MetaMath、NuminaMath和TigerLab的土耳其语翻译数据集，发现数据质量优于模型规模（Mix-30k在微调中表现最佳；大规模MetaMath表现不佳）。线性融合带来最大提升（GSM8K最高达0.63），而Ties效果较弱，Breadcrumbs/Slerp则导致性能下降。结合MCTS和思维树的搜索方法提高了LLM评判者对推理质量（0-100分制）的平均得分。局限性包括机器翻译、规模有限以及搜索的随机性。

summary: This study investigates sequential multi-task learning using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), LoRA, and 4-bit quantization on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct for mental health problem detection, emotion detection, and sentiment analysis. Using 4,243 English social media posts, it compares two task sequences and demonstrates that task ordering significantly affects knowledge transfer and task interference. The MHP-first sequence achieves the best mental health problem detection (Micro-F1: 0.7624), while the Emotion-first sequence performs better in emotion (F1: 0.6052) and sentiment analysis (F1: 0.9459). A Joint-MTL baseline further highlights the challenges of simultaneous learning, including task interference and generative format collapse. Overall, the findings demonstrate the effectiveness of sequential PEFT for mental health NLP while showing that task order is critical to balancing performance across related tasks. The integration of LoRA and 4-bit quantization also reduces computational and memory requirements, supporting the adaptation of large language models in resource-constrained environments.
title: Adapting Large Language Models via Multi-Task Learning for Mental Health Problem, Emotion, and Sentiment Detection

title_translated: 基于多任务学习适应大语言模型以检测心理健康问题、情绪与情感
summary_translated: 本研究探讨了在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct上使用参数高效微调（PEFT）、LoRA和4比特量化进行顺序多任务学习，在心理健康问题检测、情绪识别和情感分析中的应用。基于4,243条英文社交媒体帖子，比较了两种任务顺序，结果表明任务排序显著影响知识迁移和任务干扰。MHP优先序列在心理健康问题检测中表现最佳（Micro-F1: 0.7624），而情绪优先序列在情绪（F1: 0.6052）和情感分析（F1: 0.9459）上更优。联合多任务学习基线进一步揭示了同时学习带来的挑战，如任务干扰和生成格式崩溃。总体而言，研究证明了顺序PEFT在心理健康NLP中的有效性，并表明任务顺序对平衡相关任务性能至关重要。LoRA与4比特量化的结合也降低了计算和内存需求，支持在资源受限环境中适配大语言模型。

summary: This paper introduces Cascading Circle Loss (CasCL), a contrastive learning framework for legal retrieval tasks with graded relevance. CasCL combines an InfoNCE objective for positive-negative separation with a cascade of ranking boundaries that model ordered relevance levels between queries and legal clauses. The framework also includes a negative-aware self-paced optimization mechanism and a relevance gain weighting strategy to improve ranking quality. Experiments on legal passage retrieval benchmarks show that CasCL consistently outperforms existing methods, including InfoNCE, Circle Loss, MNRL and Margin MSE, across both binary retrieval and graded ranking metrics.
title: Cascading Circle Loss: Order-Preserving Contrastive Learning for Graded Legal Retrieval
title_translated: 级联圆损失：用于分级法律检索的保序对比学习
summary_translated: 本文提出了一种名为Cascading Circle Loss（CasCL）的对比学习框架，用于具有分级相关性的法律检索任务。CasCL将InfoNCE目标用于正负样本分离，并引入一系列排序边界来建模查询与法律条文之间的有序相关性层级。该框架还包含一种负样本感知的自适应优化机制和相关性增益加权策略，以提升排序质量。在法律段落检索基准上的实验表明，CasCL在二值检索和分级排序指标上均持续优于现有方法，包括InfoNCE、Circle Loss、MNRL和Margin MSE。

summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate procedures that look convincing on paper, but do they work in practice? In this paper, we propose crochet as an ideal testbed for physically grounded procedural reasoning in VLMs. Crochet cannot be reliably simulated or automated: the only way to know what a pattern produces is to make it by hand, yet verification is tangible and cheap, requiring nothing but a hook and a ball of yarn. We introduce FoundationChain, a deceptively simple test of procedural reasoning: given an image of a basic crochet object, can VLMs infer how it was made and generate a pattern that produces the same result? We crochet 40 patterns generated by four VLMs by hand. Even at this scale, physical execution not only reveals failures that automated proxies cannot detect, but also enables a more precise diagnosis of their causes and consequences: while models write fluent, convincing patterns, only four are free of errors, and our analysis exposes deficiencies in visual, geometric and procedural reasoning.
title: Evaluating Physically Grounded Procedural Reasoning in VLMs through Real-World Execution: Crochet as a Testbed
title_translated: 通过真实世界执行评估视觉-语言模型的物理基础程序推理：钩针编织作为测试平台
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够生成看似合理的程序，但这些程序在现实中是否有效？本文提出钩针编织作为评估VLM物理基础程序推理的理想测试平台。钩针编织无法被可靠模拟或自动化：唯一确认图案效果的方式是手工制作，但验证过程直观且成本低廉，仅需钩针和毛线即可完成。我们引入FoundationChain，一个看似简单却能有效检验程序推理的任务：给定一个基础钩针制品的图像，VLM能否推断其制作方式并生成可复现相同结果的图案？我们手工编织了四名VLM生成的40个图案。即使在此规模下，物理执行不仅揭示了自动化代理无法检测的失败，还实现了对其原因和后果的更精确诊断：尽管模型生成的图案流畅且有说服力，但仅有四个无错误，我们的分析暴露了模型在视觉、几何和程序推理方面的缺陷。

summary: Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies safeguard industrial processes against catastrophic accidents. Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist HAZOP drafting, yet evaluations rely on lexical overlap. Because LLMs internalize human heuristics, prompts may trigger biased judgments. Whether frontier LLMs withstand cognitive perturbations in safety-critical workflows remains unknown. Here we show across 420 trials that three frontier LLMs resisted 96.8% of cognitive manipulations, rendering overall susceptibility statistically inconclusive. Contrary to assumed broad fragility, models rejected confirmation and availability cues. However, safety-critical risk downgrades emerged under low anchors and gain frames. Thus, automated hazard analysis requires disciplined human-in-the-loop validation.
title: Behavioral Evaluation of Large Language Models Under Cognitive Biases in HAZOP Studies
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to IFAC for possible publication. Supplementary material available at this https URL
title_translated: 在HAZOP研究中认知偏见下大型语言模型的行为评估
summary_translated: 危险与可操作性（HAZOP）分析用于防范工业流程中的灾难性事故。大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地辅助HAZOP文档撰写，但现有评估依赖于词汇重叠。由于LLMs内化了人类启发式规则，提示词可能触发偏见判断。前沿LLMs在安全关键工作流中是否能抵御认知扰动尚不明确。我们在420次试验中发现，三款前沿LLMs成功抵御了96.8%的认知操纵，整体易感性统计上不显著。与普遍认为的广泛脆弱性相反，模型拒绝了确认偏差和可得性线索。然而，在低锚点和收益框架下仍出现安全风险的下调。因此，自动化危害分析需要严格的“人在回路”验证。

summary: Long-term personalized agents are increasingly expected to answer queries over user histories in which preferences, goals, and constraints evolve across interleaved conversations. Existing retrieval-based and structured-memory systems can surface relevant facts, but often return isolated memory units that do not explain which earlier preference was refined, contradicted, or superseded by later evidence. We introduce TransMem, a transition-aware memory retrieval framework that stores preference updates as explicit retrieval units alongside ordinary factual memories. During memory construction, TransMem routes user interaction history into topic-structured memory graphs, detects shift events, and grounds them as transition records. At inference time, TransMem first retrieves factual anchors and then adaptively expands over transition records, producing a compact context of factual anchors and accepted transition records. Experiments on PersonaMem and PersonaBench across two Qwen backbones show that TransMem outperforms representative retrieval-based and structured-memory baselines. Controlled analyses further show that transition records and adaptive expansion contribute beyond factual anchoring, chronological expansion, flat transition retrieval, and fixed-hop traversal. These results suggest that preference-update records are useful retrieval units for long-term personalization.
title: TransMem: Transition-Aware Retrieval for Evolving Personal Memory
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: TransMem：面向动态个人记忆的过渡感知检索
summary_translated: 长期个性化智能体日益需要在交错对话中回答关于用户历史的问题，而用户的偏好、目标和约束会随时间演变。现有的基于检索和结构化记忆系统虽然能提取相关事实，但常返回孤立的记忆单元，无法解释早期偏好是如何被后续证据修正、矛盾或取代的。我们提出TransMem，一种过渡感知的记忆检索框架，将偏好更新作为显式的检索单元与普通事实记忆一同存储。在记忆构建阶段，TransMem将用户交互历史路由到主题结构化的记忆图中，检测变化事件，并将其记录为过渡记录。在推理阶段，TransMem首先检索事实锚点，然后自适应地扩展至过渡记录，生成由事实锚点和已接受的过渡记录组成的紧凑上下文。在PersonaMem和PersonaBench两个基准上使用两种Qwen骨干模型的实验表明，TransMem优于代表性基于检索和结构化记忆的基线方法。受控分析进一步显示，过渡记录和自适应扩展的作用超越了事实锚定、时间顺序扩展、平坦过渡检索和固定跳数遍历。这些结果表明，偏好更新记录是长期个性化中有效的检索单元。

summary: Transformer-based autoregressive multilingual language models (LMs) are often assumed to store factual knowledge in an interlingua: a language-agnostic latent space. If this assumption holds, a parameter update applied in a source language during knowledge editing should inherently propagate to its semantic equivalents in target languages. However, empirical benchmarks show that cross-lingual propagation of edits often degrades substantially, a degradation that prior work treats largely as an algorithmic symptom rather than a structural bottleneck. In this work, we investigate whether representational anisotropy creates a structural bottleneck for source-only associative-memory editing, and perform a geometric dissection of the cross-lingual propagation gap. Using associative memory-based "locate-then-edit" methods, including ROME, MEMIT, and AlphaEdit, as analytical frameworks, we derive a closed-form decomposition of this gap into key-space propagation, parallel residual mismatch, and orthogonal residual mismatch. Our empirical findings show that cross-lingual propagation is primarily bottlenecked by a large orthogonal residual component, indicating that source-language edits often fail to span the target-language update directions required for successful transfer. Furthermore, we show that post-hoc correction using only source-language residual statistics encounters a large residual-prediction barrier. Finally, we perform a structural realignment via a targeted contrastive alignment objective and find that it substantially improves key-space propagation and partially improves cross-lingual edit transfer, while leaving value-space mismatch as a remaining bottleneck.
title: On the Geometric Bottlenecks of Cross-Lingual Knowledge Editing

title_translated: 跨语言知识编辑中的几何瓶颈
summary_translated: 基于Transformer的自回归多语言语言模型（LM）通常被认为将事实知识存储在一个无语言特异性的隐空间（即“通用语”）中。如果该假设成立，则在源语言中进行的知识编辑参数更新应自然传播到目标语言中的语义等价内容。然而，实证基准显示跨语言编辑传播性能显著下降，以往研究多将其视为算法性症状而非结构性瓶颈。本文探究表征各向异性是否构成仅源语言关联记忆编辑的结构性瓶颈，并对跨语言传播差距进行了几何分解。基于基于关联记忆的‘定位-编辑’方法（如ROME、MEMIT、AlphaEdit）作为分析框架，我们推导出该差距的闭式分解，包括关键空间传播、平行残差不匹配和正交残差不匹配。实证发现表明，跨语言传播主要受较大的正交残差成分制约，说明源语言编辑往往无法覆盖目标语言更新所需的方向，导致传递失败。此外，仅使用源语言残差统计进行事后校正也面临巨大的残差预测障碍。最后，我们通过针对性的对比对齐目标进行结构重对齐，发现其显著提升了关键空间传播，并部分改善了跨语言编辑传递效果，但仍存在值空间不匹配这一剩余瓶颈。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.
title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs

title_translated: AI在临床文档循环中的应用：LLM引发的笔记膨胀与诊断过度报告对下游LLM的影响
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于处理医疗记录以完成医疗任务，如临床文档。由于这些工具也能生成文档，因此其与记录的关系现在是双向的：模型既读取也写入记录。因此，理解LLM在读取已包含LLM生成内容的记录时的行为，对于其安全部署至关重要。本研究考察了医疗记录中LLM生成内容对后续读取同一记录的LLM所产生的影响。我们关注两类LLM引入的伪影：一是‘膨胀’，即LLM生成的摘要在记录中不断累积，随时间改变内容长度和来源；二是‘扭曲’，即LLM微妙地修改临床发现，而非直接虚构事实。作为扭曲的一个案例，我们研究了‘诊断过度报告’（在记录中记录未经证实的鉴别诊断），并测试其是否会传播至读取模型的输出。在来自四个家族的七种读取模型中，我们发现了这两种效应的证据。首先，与长度匹配的复制前向和模板文本相比，LLM生成的摘要笔记在下游住院过程生成中表现出轻微但一致的性能下降。其次，注入的过度报告在下游输出中以不同比率重现，且未在标准质量指标中表现出可检测的变化。这些发现表明，必须监控医疗记录中的AI生成内容，并在后续由AI处理时予以考虑。

summary: Diffusion large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, enabling parallel generation through iterative denoising. Recent guidance methods improve diffusion LLMs by introducing a weak model to guide the prediction of the base model during denoising. However, the influence of the weak model during denoising remains less clear, and computing its prediction requires an additional forward pass at each denoising step. We present in this paper an in-depth analysis of how diffusion LLMs use contextual information during denoising. Our analysis reveals that diffusion LLMs rely more heavily on local context while often underutilizing global context. Based on this observation, we introduce Global Context Guidance (GCG), a feature-space guidance method that enhances global-context utilization without constructing an explicit weak model. Extensive experiments on LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B, and LLaDA-1.5 across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GCG consistently outperforms existing guidance methods, while incurring much lower inference overhead.
title: Global Context Guidance for Diffusion Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 扩散型大语言模型的全局上下文引导
summary_translated: 扩散型大语言模型（LLMs）最近成为自回归LLMs的一种有前景的替代方案，通过迭代去噪实现并行生成。近期的引导方法通过引入一个弱模型，在去噪过程中指导基础模型的预测。然而，弱模型在去噪过程中的影响仍不够清晰，且计算其预测需要在每个去噪步骤中额外执行一次前向传播。本文对扩散LLMs在去噪过程中如何利用上下文信息进行了深入分析。我们的分析发现，扩散LLMs更依赖局部上下文，而常常低估全局上下文的利用。基于此观察，我们提出了全局上下文引导（GCG），一种特征空间引导方法，可在不构建显式弱模型的情况下增强全局上下文的利用。在LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B和LLaDA-1.5等多个基准上的大量实验表明，GCG始终优于现有引导方法，同时推理开销显著更低。

summary: Query-Key Normalization (QK-Norm) is widely adopted in modern large language models to control the growth of attention logits and improve training stability. However, query and key norms are not merely sources of instability. The query norm controls the sharpness of the attention distribution, while the key norm determines how strongly a token attracts different queries. These norms therefore carry token-specific information about attention selectivity and token importance. By normalizing both, QK-Norm suppresses this information. This raises a natural question: can we control query-key representations without discarding their sensitivity to magnitude? To address this question, we propose QK-MAP, a Magnitude-Aware Projection for constructing queries and keys. Rather than removing magnitude through normalization, QK-MAP transforms the input representation using multiple learnable frequencies, so that changes in magnitude are encoded as bounded phase patterns. This allows magnitude to be represented through phase and direction rather than vector length alone. Its periodic features have a fixed norm while remaining sensitive to magnitude changes, separating magnitude encoding from norm growth. Multiple frequencies further help distinguish magnitudes and reduce periodic ambiguity. Experiments across model scales from 190M to 7B parameters show that QK-MAP achieves lower training and validation loss than both Standard attention and QK-Norm. Further analyses show that QK-MAP preserves sensitivity to input scale, assigns less attention to the first token, and produces stronger attention contrast for relevant evidence in synthetic long-context tests. These results demonstrate that query-key scale can be effectively controlled without sacrificing token-specific magnitude information.
title: Large Language Models without QK-Normalization
comment: Code is available at this https URL
title_translated: 无需QK归一化的大型语言模型
summary_translated: 查询-键归一化（QK-Norm）在现代大型语言模型中被广泛采用，以控制注意力logits的增长并提升训练稳定性。然而，查询和键的归一化不仅仅是不稳定的来源。查询归一化控制注意力分布的锐度，而键归一化决定某个标记吸引不同查询的强度。因此，这些归一化携带了关于注意力选择性和标记重要性的特定于标记的信息。通过同时归一化两者，QK-Norm抑制了这些信息。这引出一个自然问题：我们能否在不丢弃对幅度敏感性的情况下控制查询-键表示？为解决此问题，我们提出QK-MAP，一种用于构建查询和键的幅度感知投影。不同于通过归一化消除幅度，QK-MAP使用多个可学习频率变换输入表示，使幅度变化编码为有界相位模式。这使得幅度可通过相位和方向而非仅向量长度来表示。其周期性特征具有固定范数，同时保持对幅度变化的敏感性，将幅度编码与范数增长分离。多个频率进一步有助于区分幅度并减少周期模糊性。在从190M到7B参数规模的多种模型上的实验表明，QK-MAP在训练和验证损失上均优于标准注意力和QK-Norm。进一步分析显示，QK-MAP保留了对输入尺度的敏感性，减少了对首个标记的关注，并在合成长上下文测试中为相关证据产生更强的注意力对比。这些结果表明，可以在不牺牲标记特定幅度信息的前提下有效控制查询-键尺度。

summary: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.
title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
comment: 18 pages
title_translated: onóna：带有共享解嵌入的双嵌入
summary_translated: 参数共享可降低语言模型的参数成本，但传统的共享输出头仅限于单一softmax。我们提出onóna，一种双表参数化方法，在保持输入输出参数共享的同时提升了输出表达能力。Transformer将两个嵌入表的平均值作为输入，输出头则结合由相同表格定义的softmax分布。一个仅依赖当前输入标记的门控机制决定混合权重，其值可在推理时预先计算，且Transformer主体保持不变。我们在142M、330M和1B规模的密集模型、门控DeltaNet混合模型、专家混合模型以及注意力残差架构上评估了onóna。在匹配的token预算下，onóna在12次比较中有11次降低了最终验证损失和外部困惑度，并在12次中的10次提高了八个下游任务的平均准确率。唯一例外出现在1B MoE模型的损失表现上。代价是增加一个额外的嵌入表和一个额外的词汇投影。

summary: Translating historical cultural heritage poses profound challenges for machine translation systems due to the acute semantic asymmetry across eras and cultures, where terse classical syntax frequently obscures domain-specific cultural knowledge. While Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generic translation benchmarks, they struggle to negotiate Culturally-Specific Items and diachronic shifts in domain-rich historical texts, such as Yellow River cultural records. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce YRC-Bench, the first human-curated, multi-parallel benchmark dedicated to historical heritage translation across Classical Chinese, Modern Chinese, and nine target foreign languages. YRC-Bench establishes a tri-level parallel corpus incorporating modern explanatory glosses as explicit semantic bridges and operationalizes translation strategies through paired conserved versus substituted CSI variants categorized by cultural translatability. Systematic evaluations of nine leading LLMs across bidirectional translation directions reveal that leveraging modern Chinese glosses - especially human-curated ones - dramatically elevates both lexical fidelity and semantic adequacy. Furthermore, multidimensional human preference audits by native experts unveil distinct cross-cultural preferences between Sinographic-tradition and non-Sinographic language groups.
title: YRC-Bench: Benchmarking Culturally Aware Machine Translation for Historical Heritage via Tri-Level Semantic Bridging
title_translated: YRC-Bench：通过三级语义桥接对历史遗产进行文化感知机器翻译的基准测试
summary_translated: 由于时代与文化之间的深刻语义不对称，历史文化遗产的翻译对机器翻译系统构成重大挑战，其中简洁的古典语法常掩盖特定领域的文化知识。尽管大型语言模型在通用翻译基准中表现出色，但在处理富含领域信息的历史文本（如黄河文化记录）中的文化特异性项目和历时性变化时仍显不足。为弥合这一关键差距，我们引入YRC-Bench，这是首个由人工精心构建的多语言平行基准，专注于古典中文、现代中文与九种目标外语之间的历史遗产翻译。YRC-Bench建立了一个三级平行语料库，包含现代解释性注释作为显式的语义桥梁，并通过按文化可译性分类的保留与替换型文化特异性项目变体来操作翻译策略。对九个领先LLM在双向翻译方向上的系统评估表明，利用现代中文注释——尤其是人工标注的——显著提升了词汇忠实度和语义充分性。此外，母语专家进行的多维度偏好审计揭示了汉字传统语言群体与非汉字传统语言群体之间存在明显的跨文化偏好差异。

summary: Multi-turn revision often asks a model to replace an earlier organizing frame while preserving still-valid facts and artifact requirements. Existing instruction-following evaluations mainly assess the latest target and may therefore score an artifact as successful even when it adopts the new frame but exposes the superseded one. We call this failure an abandoned-frame verbalization error (AFVE). AFVE-Bench evaluates silent frame replacement in English and Chinese using 192 matched four-turn dialogues across eight writing domains. Each seed has zero, one, or two pre-target user requests to generate under the source frame. AFVE eligibility depends on the user-request history and applies to the one- and two-request conditions; the zero-request condition serves as a frame-bearing baseline. Eleven model configurations yielded 4,224 expected post-target response units. Two annotators independently scored 4,204 scorable responses for target adoption, source-frame verbalization, and direct usability; model and condition metadata were hidden, and disagreements were adjudicated. AFVE occurs in 25.54% (715/2,799) of history-conditioned responses. Of 2,388 target-passing history-conditioned responses, 472 (19.77%) still expose the abandoned source frame, most often through contrastive framing (423/472). For these standalone revision tasks, target adoption does not ensure source-frame silence.
title: AFVE-Bench: Measuring Abandoned-Frame Verbalization Errors in Multi-Turn LLM Revision

title_translated: AFVE-Bench：衡量多轮LLM修订中的废弃框架表述错误
summary_translated: 多轮修订通常要求模型在保留仍有效的事实和产物需求的前提下替换先前的组织框架。现有的指令遵循评估主要关注最新目标，因此可能在模型采用新框架但暴露已被取代的旧框架时仍将其评分成功。我们将这种失败称为废弃框架表述错误（AFVE）。AFVE-Bench使用192组匹配的四轮对话，在英语和中文中评估了这一现象，涵盖八个写作领域。每个种子包含零个、一个或两个在源框架下生成的用户请求。AFVE的适用性取决于用户请求历史，适用于一请求和两请求情形；零请求情形作为带框架的基线。共产生11种模型配置下的4,224个预期后目标响应单元。两名标注员独立评分4,204个可评分响应，评估目标采纳、源框架表述及直接可用性；模型和条件元数据被隐藏，分歧由仲裁解决。在2,799个历史条件响应中，AFVE发生率为25.54%（715/2,799）。在2,388个通过目标测试的历史条件响应中，有472个（19.77%）仍暴露被废弃的源框架，大多数通过对比性框架实现（423/472）。对于这些独立的修订任务，目标采纳并不保证源框架的沉默。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in social, behavioural, and decision-making research, yet it remains unclear whether they can express graded cognitive diversity as assigned when engaging in simulated behaviour. We introduce a cognition-suite evaluation that tests whether simulated populations reproduce human variation in reasoning, self-reported traits, their associations, and downstream behaviour. Agents conditioned on synthetic or human-derived profiles of cognitive reflection, Need for Cognition, and Big Five personality answer the same suite as a cohort of 473 adults: two newly assembled tests, a Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) and a Behavioural Reflection Test (BRT) whose decision scenarios measure reflection in behaviour, alongside an established CRT and the two trait questionnaires. Across seven full-battery simulation runs of four models, agents recover Need for Cognition and Big Five trait distributions on self-report questionnaires, but fall short on simulating diversity of cognitive task performance and downstream behaviours. In the four Claude Sonnet 4.6 runs, every agent scores full marks on both CRTs, whatever reflection level its persona was assigned. In the other three runs agents make intuitive-lure errors (the tempting wrong answers CRT items invite), but 49 to 85% score full marks, against under 10% in the human sample. Claude Sonnet 5 comes closest to people's item-by-item pattern of lures; the other two runs give fewer lures and vary less between items. In the BRT scenarios, every run over-produces 8 to 11 of 15 coded behaviours by at least 20 percentage points, and people's links between reflection and behaviour carry over only in part. Useful synthetic populations must preserve not only trait descriptors but the structured variation in reasoning, error type, and behaviour those descriptors are meant to organise.
title: Imperfectly Imperfect: Evaluating Graded Cognitive Diversity in LLM Persona Simulations
