title_translated: 实践准确率掩盖的成本：自生成训练数据中的示范解法与新规则的组合使用
summary_translated: 示范解法可使自生成训练目标更短且成本更低，但对已练习操作的准确率可能掩盖模型重用新学规则的能力。我们研究了一个20亿参数推理模型学习两个虚构定量规则时的这一选择。模型仅从规则表或规则表加程序编写示范解法生成目标；目标在最终答案正确性上被接受，但在微调和评估时移除支持信息。训练问题要求在一个片段中进行前向使用；组合使用则要求在两个片段中连续重用同一规则。经过六轮训练后，仅使用规则表的目标在前瞻性测试中组合任务表现领先24.3个百分点（95%置信区间14.6-34.0）。在未见过的参数值下，前向准确率相同（均为87.5%），但组合准确率分别为58.3%和23.6%，差距达34.7个百分点（25.7-43.8）。独立采样的第二组目标数据重复了相同趋势（+14.6分，2.1-26.0）。在十轮训练较短的示范解法目标后（约相当于六轮仅规则表训练的领域词元量，其他训练量变化），第一组数据差距缩小至16.3点（6.3-26.7），第二组缩小至6.2点（-6.3至18.8），此时预设测试不再成立。在六轮训练下，示范解法策略使用的捕获词元更少、更新时间更短，但训练模型在数值签名下每成功一次组合需生成2.6倍的词元（第二组为2.1倍）。因此，选择捕获上下文需测试新规则的重用能力，同时考虑这些使用的推理成本，而不能仅依赖前向准确率。

summary: Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.
title: A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone

title_translated: 注意力的一个几何不变量可仅从权重预测头的专化
summary_translated: Transformer架构在注意力机制中具有连续对称性。我们推导出一个标量不变量ρ，用于衡量每个注意力头与旋转位置编码耦合的能力。该框架使我们无需前向传播即可分析注意力头，开辟了对现代大语言模型进行数据无关分析的新方向。实证研究表明，在四个无偏置RoPE模型（参数量从1.35亿到70亿）中，ρ与最广泛研究的机械可解释性电路类型——归纳头（induction heads）具有显著相关性，Spearman相关系数在-0.55至-0.74之间。作为初步概念验证，我们使用ρ仅对前50%的位置头应用YaRN，其困惑度下降程度小于均匀应用。代码已开源：https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant。

summary: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
title_translated: TS-GEAR：淘宝上淘生成式广告召回
summary_translated: 按需配送平台如DoorDash和Uber Eats引入了传统电商中不存在的约束：超出用户配送范围的商户无效，而非仅排名较低。生成式召回近年来在大规模召回系统中展现出强大潜力。然而，将其应用于此类场景面临三大挑战：第一，现有语义ID仅将地理信息作为软信号编码，导致可达性只能依赖不可微的后生成硬截断；第二，用户偏好在区域和查询间差异显著，若不根据地理和当前查询条件聚合历史行为，则会产生有偏的兴趣估计；第三，召回候选集的评估基于整体价值，但自回归训练独立评分每个序列，缺乏集合层面信号来抑制冗余近似重复。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TS-GEAR，一个面向按需配送的统一生成式召回框架：(1) 地理-语义ID将商户标识符拆分为地理前缀和语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤；(2) 查询-地理目标注意力利用实时查询和位置作为双重目标聚合历史行为，同时将每个行为自身的位置编码进其注意力键；(3) GMPO（组边际策略优化）通过去重后的组奖励和GRPO中的边际优势重写优势函数，避免引入辅助多样性目标。部署于轻量级0.1B骨干网络，TS-GEAR在淘宝上淘搜索广告管道中日均服务超1.5亿次查询，持续优于最先进的生成式召回方法，在命中率和地理有效性上表现优异，并实现广告曝光量提升3.8%、广告收入提升4.2%。

summary: Full-pipeline data analysis over real-world data lakes requires LLM agents to locate and integrate information across large collections of tables with different schemas. Existing data agents follow task-specific exploration, which exhausts the context window in massive lakes. As the context fills, the agent's reasoning degrades, leading it to locate and process incorrect data files. These errors propagate into the final answer. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Ontology-Grounded Data Agent (OGDA), which utilizes a compact ontology to reduce exploration overhead and constrain data processing. OGDA constructs the ontology through agentic hypothesis testing. At each step, a proposer agent induces schemas, concepts, and relations from raw sources, and a verifier checks each proposal against the underlying data. During task execution, the ontology serves as a representation of the data lake for the agent to explore. Every data-processing action is constrained by a task graph, which the agent can extend only after observing the semantic meaning of the data. Across KramaBench and DiscoveryBench with three LLM backbones, OGDA outperforms the strongest baselines by up to 10.82 points. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the data lake is a key step toward reliable end-to-end data agents.
title: OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes
title_translated: OGDA：基于本体的数据智能体，用于异构数据湖的可靠分析
summary_translated: 在真实世界数据湖上进行全链路数据分析，要求大语言模型智能体能够跨大量具有不同模式的表格定位并整合信息。现有数据智能体采用任务特定探索方式，导致在大规模数据湖中耗尽上下文窗口。随着上下文填满，智能体推理能力下降，导致错误地定位和处理数据文件，这些错误会传递至最终答案。为克服这些局限，我们引入基于本体的数据智能体（OGDA），利用紧凑本体减少探索开销并约束数据处理。OGDA通过智能体假设检验构建本体：每一步中，提议者智能体从原始源中推导出模式、概念和关系，验证者则根据底层数据检查每项提议。在任务执行过程中，本体作为数据湖的表示供智能体探索。每个数据处理动作都受任务图约束，智能体只有在观察到数据的语义含义后才能扩展该图。在KramaBench和DiscoveryBench三个LLM骨干上，OGDA相比最强基线最高提升10.82分。这些结果表明，显式建模数据湖是实现可靠端到端数据智能体的关键步骤。

summary: A model that takes over another model's conversation must normally re-read the whole history; a text hand-off shortens the re-read only by dropping content. KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA latents translate with token-wise linear maps; recurrent states are copied with a closed-form correction or synthesised by replaying the target's own recurrence. Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens. Segment-wise multi-turn transfer stays at the re-prefill level; naive re-translation collapses. On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.
title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers

title_translated: 混合注意力语言模型之间KV缓存的转换：MLA潜在表示、线性注意力状态与稀疏注意力索引器
summary_translated: 一个接管另一个模型对话的模型通常需要重新读取整个历史记录；文本交接仅通过丢弃内容来缩短重读时间。KV缓存转换则将源模型的缓存映射到目标模型的格式中，使目标模型无需重新读取即可从完整上下文中继续。该方法适用于分组查询注意力（GQA），但当前前沿的开放权重模型现在缓存压缩后的潜在表示（MLA）、稀疏注意力索引键和固定大小的线性注意力状态。我们在一个GQA对上复现了KV-Lingo，并针对每种对象，给出了捕获和注入的位置以及达到原生质量的机制。我们研究了两个混合模型对在16-48B规模下的双向情况，包括Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B（MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention）和Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B（门控DeltaNet混合模型），以及一个稀疏注意力目标（Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）。MLA潜在表示通过逐标记的线性映射进行转换；递归状态通过闭式修正复制或通过重放目标自身的递归过程合成。精确的长距离召回需要标记身份：从源模型第0层MLA潜在表示解码标记ID，可将针状召回率从0.09提升至2-32K范围内的0.99，64K范围内为0.83-1.00，是训练最长提示长度的八倍。混合全MLA方向在所有任务指标上均处于配对置信区间内，相同形状的GDN混合模型在双向中均达到原生水平（除继承自源模型的6%拒绝率外），首次生成时间分别比64K标记重读快18.7倍和46.8倍。分段多轮转移保持在重预填充水平；朴素的再翻译会崩溃。在稀疏注意力目标上，预测的索引键与目标自身键具有相同的针状召回能力（单个种子）。我们提出假设，这些方法如何推广至300B+的混合旗舰模型。

summary: Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised tokens and consistently outperforms off-policy distillation on the held-out test set. On a forgetting stress test, SSD retains the most general capability while also achieving the best in-domain accuracy and using less supervision than the on-policy baseline. Overall, SSD establishes a new accuracy-efficiency-forgetting Pareto frontier for self-distillation.
title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization

title_translated: 推测性自蒸馏实现高效知识内化
summary_translated: 许多现实应用要求语言模型内化预训练中未包含的知识，以整合持续更新的事实或学习新领域技能。自蒸馏已成为解决此任务的自然方法。一个基于源材料条件的模型作为教师，而一个无条件的学生模型被训练以在闭卷状态下重现教师的行为。我们提出推测性自蒸馏（SSD），一种高效的逐标记混合策略自蒸馏方法。学生默认生成每个轨迹，而教师仅在下一标记分布与学生显著偏离的位置介入。与使用教师生成前缀的离策略蒸馏不同，这种设计使训练轨迹保持接近学生测试时的行为，同时避免了完全在策略轨迹漂移进入低信号状态的问题。实际上，SSD让教师仅在特权上下文改变预测的关键位置引导轨迹。在三个衡量事实召回、知识更新和技能习得的闭卷问答基准上，SSD几乎达到在策略蒸馏的效果，同时使用的监督标记减少38-69%，并在保留测试集上始终优于离策略蒸馏。在遗忘压力测试中，SSD在保持最通用能力的同时，也实现了最佳领域准确率，且所需监督少于在策略基线。总体而言，SSD为自蒸馏建立了新的准确性-效率-遗忘帕累托前沿。

summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
title_translated: Infrathon：面向真实世界长期智能基础设施优化的语言代理基准测试
summary_translated: 本文研究前沿代理是否能在长期范围内持续改进真实世界的AI基础设施。我们引入Infrathon，一个涵盖不同层级的多样化、长期智能基础设施优化任务的基准。我们在150次运行中评估了六种模型，总预算为24小时，总计超过10,000 GPU小时。结果表明，模型排名随评估周期变化，而150次运行中有135次在预算后半段仍实现进一步改进。这些发现表明，短期评估可能忽略优化收益及模型相对性能的变化。我们还发现，代理能够发现优于人工设计基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5将平均KV缓存压缩比从人类设计的Quant-VideoGen编码器的6.82%提升至19.86%。对代理轨迹的分析识别出任务违规、不可靠测试和过早完成是持续改进的障碍。综上，我们的Infrathon框架为构建长期任务、评估前沿代理和发现优质基础设施解决方案提供了资源。

summary: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.
title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?

title_translated: CHO-Bench：上下文提示如何影响LLM广告中的广告排名？
summary_translated: LLM广告根据用户对话选择广告，其中用户需求可能超出显式的商品搜索。ChatGPT广告允许广告商提供自然语言的上下文提示，描述其提供的内容、可能感兴趣的用户以及适用时机，作为跨多样化用户对话中广告排名的额外信息。然而，如何有效构建这些提示仍不明确。我们将上下文提示优化（CHO）定义为在给定预算下构建提示以提升广告排名的问题。基于成熟的营销框架，我们开发了七种覆盖‘什么’、‘谁’和‘何时’的上下文提示生成策略，并提出一个综合策略，融合所有七个维度。我们引入CHO-Bench，并在五个数据集上使用基于嵌入和基于LLM的排序器进行了超过119万次成对评估。结果显示，上下文提示在所评估的离线排序器下提升了广告排名。尽管各单一策略的平均增益相似，综合策略并未表现出一致优势，但在特定生成-排序配置下，策略差异更为显著，基于嵌入和基于LLM的排序器偏好不同的信息维度。增加提示预算进一步提升排名，但边际收益递减。这些发现建立了一个用于研究LLM广告侧排名优化的离线基准，并突显了模型特定提示选择、预算感知生成与聚合的机会。

summary: Language is central to social communication, which is altered in autism, and language abilities vary widely among autistic individuals. How the autistic brain processes language is central to understanding autistic communication. Yet neuroimaging studies report inconsistent findings on how autistic brain activity is altered during language processing. We synthesized 45 fMRI and PET studies (753 autistic and 777 non-autistic participants) with seed-based d mapping with permutation of subject images (SDM-PSI). We estimated autistic and non-autistic activation and their difference with meta-regressions adjusted for each study's language modality and mean age. Autistic and non-autistic brains activated a similar left-lateralized language network. Autistic brains showed reduced activity throughout the left perisylvian cortex, from the inferior frontal gyrus to the mid superior temporal gyrus and the posterior superior temporal sulcus, and increased activity in the right temporal pole. Spoken language showed a larger autistic reduction than written language in the left mid superior temporal gyrus. Adults, but not children and adolescents, showed increased autistic activity in the right superior temporal gyrus and cuneus. Autistic language processing thus relies on the typical left-lateralized network but shows reduced leftward lateralization.
title: Language processing in the autistic brain: A meta-analysis of neuroimaging studies across modalities and age

title_translated: 自闭症大脑中的语言处理：跨模态与年龄的神经影像学研究元分析
summary_translated: 语言是社会交流的核心，而自闭症中的社会交流能力存在改变，且自闭症个体的语言能力差异巨大。理解自闭症大脑如何处理语言是理解自闭症沟通的关键。然而，神经影像学研究在自闭症大脑语言处理过程中活动变化方面报告了不一致的结果。我们整合了45项fMRI和PET研究（共753名自闭症参与者和777名非自闭症参与者），采用基于种子的差异映射与受试者图像置换（SDM-PSI）方法。通过元回归分析，调整每项研究的语言模态和平均年龄，估计自闭症与非自闭症大脑的激活及其差异。自闭症与非自闭症大脑激活了类似的左半球偏侧化语言网络。自闭症大脑在整个左外侧裂皮层活动减少，包括额下回至中上颞回和后上颞沟，同时右颞极活动增加。在口语语言中，自闭症在左中上颞回的活动减少程度大于书面语言。成年人（而非儿童和青少年）在右上颞回和楔叶显示出自闭症活动增加。因此，自闭症语言处理依赖典型的左半球偏侧化网络，但表现出较弱的左半球偏侧化。

summary: Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/.
title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 谱系遗忘：保持Transformer结构的语言模型遗忘方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的机器遗忘旨在移除特定的学习知识、能力或行为，同时保持模型的实用性。现有方法主要关注遗忘目标的设计，而忽略了Transformer权重的内在矩阵结构。特别是，标准优化器在独立的标量坐标上操作，从而忽视了这种矩阵结构。我们提出了谱系遗忘，一种将标准遗忘目标与矩阵结构化优化相结合的更新框架。我们证明，谱系更新对应于由归一化输入和输出的线性层组成的Transformer的最速下降方向。该方法可应用于现有遗忘方法之上，并在记忆、隐私和实用性三个互补维度上进行评估，通过其调和平均值总结。谱系遗忘始终优于广泛的基线方法，并接近保留训练参考模型的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/ 获取。

summary: Answer probes applied to chain-of-thought hidden states are often read as evidence that a language model has already decided its final response. This reading overlooks a competing signal, the candidate the model is about to mention. We introduce emission-controlled dual-target probing (ECDP), which fits the same low-rank reader family separately to the imminent mention and to the final answer at identical positions, with target-specific nulls and thresholds fixed before any fit. On correct DecisionDepth (DD) rollouts in which a distractor is mentioned before the final answer, Qwen3.5-4B decodes the next mention at .966 (null .234) but the final answer only at .221 (null .186), an emission gap of .696 [.648, .744]; Llama-3.1-8B gives .575 [.514, .632]. This pattern is not universal. In a pre-specified evaluation of Qwen3-8B with thinking enabled on held-out MMLU questions, using a full-prefix attention reader over every thinking position, both targets are decodable and the final answer is read far more strongly (mention-minus-answer lift -.398 [-.459, -.336] at layer 22 over 467 questions). Model, task, positions, and reader change together between these settings, and an attempted matched comparison on DD produced no valid statistics because the imminent-mention probe did not train reliably, so we do not identify what reverses the order. On DD, planted-signal controls show that the reader recovers an injected final-answer signal at one tenth of full dose. Answer-candidate decodability is therefore target-relative and protocol-dependent: a strong answer readout does not by itself establish when a model commits, and a probe that fails to train is not evidence that the information is absent. ECDP is a practical control for distinguishing imminent text emission from evidence of a settled decision.
title: When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought

title_translated: 答案解码性并非决策：链式思维中最终答案与即将发出信号的分离
summary_translated: 对链式思维隐藏状态应用的答案探测常被解读为语言模型已决定最终回答的证据。这种解读忽略了另一个竞争信号——模型即将提及的候选内容。我们引入了发射控制双目标探测（ECDP），在同一低秩阅读器家族中分别对即将提及的内容和最终答案在相同位置进行拟合，目标特定的零值和阈值在任何拟合前固定。在正确决策深度（DD）回溯中，当干扰项出现在最终答案之前时，Qwen3.5-4B 解码下一个提及的概率为 .966（零值 .234），但最终答案仅为 .221（零值 .186），存在 .696 [.648, .744] 的发射差距；Llama-3.1-8B 则为 .575 [.514, .632]。这一模式并非普遍成立。在对 Qwen3-8B 在保留 MMLU 问题上的预设评估中，启用思考功能并使用全前缀注意力阅读器遍历每个思考位置，两个目标均可解码，且最终答案的读取强度远高于提及内容（第22层相比467个问题，提及减去答案提升 -.398 [-.459, -.336]）。模型、任务、位置和阅读器在这些设置中同时变化，尝试在DD上进行匹配比较时因即时提及探测未能可靠训练而无法产生有效统计结果，因此无法确定何种因素逆转了顺序。在DD中，植入信号控制显示，阅读器能以十分之一剂量恢复注入的最终答案信号。因此，答案候选解码性是目标相对且协议依赖的：强答案读出本身并不能说明模型何时做出承诺，而探测未成功训练也不意味着信息不存在。ECDP是一种实用的控制手段，用于区分即将发出的文本与已定决策的证据。

summary: When competing campaigns target a population of large language model (LLM) agents, observed opinion changes may reflect both campaign influence and changes that would occur without intervention. We study how the timing of campaign expenditure and the population's own evolution shape outcomes in a network of persona-conditioned LLM agents that exchange and revise opinions in natural language. A proponent and a challenger are tasked with generating opposing messages under equal delivery budgets, while a separate stance probe measures opinions without influencing the simulation. Across eight claims, we compare single-campaign and competitive conditions against matched no-campaign runs, and evaluate all nine combinations of early, sustained, and late spending on a reference topic. Baseline stance drift varies substantially across claims and, on some, accounts for a sizeable fraction of apparent campaign effects. After accounting for this drift, the direction of observed campaign-associated changes aligns more closely with the claim's epistemic standing than with the campaigner's assigned role. Uninfluenced populations also consistently lose stance diversity, demonstrating that directional opinion change and convergence are distinct phenomena. In networks with two opinion-segregated communities, campaigns primarily reduce differences between communities rather than diversity within them. LLM campaign agents do not always argue for their assigned positions, particularly when these conflict with established evidence. Finally, campaign outcomes depend on the opponent's expenditure schedule: unlike a matched numerical bounded-confidence population receiving interventions at the same times and locations, the LLM population exhibits a payoff structure with no pure-strategy equilibrium.
title: Competing Influence in LLM Populations: Budget Timing and Baseline Drift
title_translated: LLM群体中的竞争影响：预算时机与基准漂移
summary_translated: 当多个宣传活动针对大型语言模型（LLM）代理群体时，观察到的意见变化可能既反映宣传活动的影响，也包含无干预情况下本就会发生的演变。我们研究了宣传支出时机以及群体自身演进如何塑造一个基于人格条件的LLM代理网络中的结果，这些代理以自然语言交换并修订意见。一名支持者和一名挑战者在相等的投放预算下被要求生成对立信息，同时通过独立立场探测器测量意见而不影响模拟过程。针对八个命题，我们将单个宣传与竞争条件与匹配的无宣传运行进行比较，并在参考主题上评估早期、持续和晚期支出的九种组合。基准立场漂移在不同命题间差异显著，某些情况下占明显宣传效应的相当大比例。在扣除此漂移后，观察到的宣传相关变化方向更贴近命题的真理性，而非宣传者的角色分配。未受干预的群体也一致丧失立场多样性，表明方向性意见变化与收敛是不同的现象。在具有两个意见隔离社区的网络中，宣传活动主要减少社区间的差异，而非社区内部的多样性。LLM宣传代理并不总是为其分配立场辩护，尤其当这些立场与已有证据冲突时。最后，宣传活动的结果取决于对手的支出时间表：与在相同时间和地点接收干预的数值受限信心群体不同，LLM群体表现出无纯策略均衡的收益结构。

summary: Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. We argue that shared reasoning in Connected Robotics should be evaluated as an evidence-to-belief trajectory, and introduce the Connected Robotics Evidence Graph (CREG) Benchmark to make that trajectory measurable. CREG comprises 350 deterministically generated scenarios across seven regimes (justified revision, belief preservation, relation association, contradiction onset and resolution, stale/delayed evidence, and source reliability), each exposing a normative posterior reference at every evidence prefix, validated by an independent log-odds checker and screened by a blinded expert audit. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p<0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. Third, belief accuracy is strongly non-monotonic along the evidence sequence, with mid-trajectory failures that endpoint-only evaluation cannot detect. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.
title: A Benchmark and Layered Evaluation Protocol for Evidence-Grounded Shared Belief Updating in Connected Robotics

title_translated: 面向连接机器人中证据基础共享信念更新的基准与分层评估协议
summary_translated: 连接的物理系统融合来自机器人、物联网传感器和边缘AI模块的观测数据，形成对世界的共享认知，但大多数评估仅评分最终答案或动作，无法判断方法是否正确归因证据、更新信念、处理矛盾以及合理化决策。我们认为，连接机器人中的共享推理应作为从证据到信念的轨迹来评估，并引入连接机器人证据图（CREG）基准以使该轨迹可度量。CREG包含350个确定性生成的场景，涵盖七个范式（合理修正、信念保持、关系关联、矛盾出现与解决、过时/延迟证据、源可靠性），每个证据前缀均暴露规范后验参考，经独立对数几率检查器验证并通过盲审专家审计筛选。九种表示条件将关系内容与序列化、排序和元数据分离。对四种开源指令模型和六种透明融合基线的评估得出三项发现。第一，实体定位解释了弱模型缺陷的很大一部分。第二，在依赖关系的场景中，删除语义关系导致严格信念状态准确率下降15.3分（Holm校正p<0.001），但信息匹配的结构化列表表现优于完整图，且打乱图不会造成损害：关系内容在需要时才重要，而图的序列化并无一致优势。第三，信念准确性沿证据序列呈强烈非单调性，存在中期轨迹失败，这是仅评估终点所无法检测的。所有场景、参考、提示、度量和分析代码均已发布，支持离线、无需硬件的复现。

summary: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.
title: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
title_translated: 创意引导：解耦过程与成果以摆脱创意悖论
summary_translated: 人工智能带来的许多最具影响力的进展，如治愈疾病、发明新技术乃至提出新科学理论，本质上都是创造性行为。然而，创造力因其独特的学习难题而难以习得，因为它面临一个创意悖论：学习重复过去的创造性成功案例会使这些具体例子更易重现，从而抑制了所期望的创造力。本文主张将创造力更好地建模为一个显式过程，而非个体作品的属性，并提出学习背后创造过程的生成原则。具体而言，为摆脱悖论，我们引入创意引导（CP），其中训练好的引导模型生成特定于提示的引导词，协助响应模型实现创造性，明确解耦创造过程与响应生成。引导模型通过GRPO学习，奖励那些引导词能带来新颖、高质量且多样响应的方案，从而强化产生创造性响应的过程，而不强化任何特定响应。

summary: Many major scientific advances come from approaching a problem with a new or novel perspective. While large language models (LLMs) with internet-scale knowledge seem poised to take such perspectives, their consistent generation remains elusive. Instead, models are drawn to dominant views and preexisting, in-field bias. To explore the potential of fresh eyes to increase creativity, this paper proposes naive LLMs, models that are made intentionally ignorant of a specific topic. Through deprivation in training or intentional forgetting, naive models are unburdened by existing dogma, allowing them to be free to make new associations and conjectures. These naive models can then be paired with a stronger mentor model that can refine their unique perspectives into concrete proposals. For the 1B and 7B models tested in this paper, naive models consistently produce seed ideas that are more novel and useful than baseline counterparts, and mentor refinement improves the ideas even further. Thus, contrary to the prevailing tradition of scaling up training data, we demonstrate a case where less information is actually more powerful, in particular when the aim is to discover genuinely outside-the-box solutions.
title: The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity
title_translated: 未知的价值：通过天真LLM的全新视角激发创造力
summary_translated: 许多重大的科学突破源于以新视角或独特方式看待问题。尽管大规模语言模型（LLMs）具备互联网规模的知识，似乎具备这种新视角的潜力，但其持续生成新颖观点仍难以实现。相反，模型往往倾向于主流观点和领域内固有的偏见。为探索全新视角对创造力的提升潜力，本文提出‘天真LLM’的概念——即在特定主题上故意无知的模型。通过训练中的剥夺或有意遗忘，这些模型摆脱了既有教条的束缚，能够自由地建立新的关联与假设。随后，这些天真模型可与一个更强的导师模型配对，由后者将其独特的观点提炼为具体提案。在本文测试的1B和7B模型中，天真模型始终产生比基线模型更新颖且更有用的创意种子，而导师的优化进一步提升了这些想法的质量。因此，与普遍追求更大训练数据的趋势相反，我们展示了在寻求真正突破性解决方案时，信息越少反而可能越强大。

summary: Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model's answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions --- discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification --- and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity's Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.
title: ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation
title_translated: ODSA：协调发现与自我聚合
summary_translated: 推理时扩展通过增加推理时间的计算量来提升语言模型答案的准确性。现有方法要么顺序执行，多次迭代修正单一解法；要么并行生成多个独立解法后进行选择。本文提出ODSA（协调发现与自我聚合），一种由LLM主导的扩展框架：一个协调器LLM将现有的推理时扩展方法作为动作指令——发现新的独立解法、比较现有解法以构建更优解、接受提议的答案并触发验证——并调度无状态工作节点执行这些任务。协调器本身不解决问题，而是分配计算资源，将前序动作的结果输入后续动作，并在单一上下文中做出每一步决策，确保每个决策都基于此前所有尝试的信息。在‘人类最后的考试’任务中，ODSA相较于单次直接调用模型（无推理时扩展），使三个模型的准确率提升4.7至18.0分；在LiveCodeBench任务中，尽管单次调用已解决大部分问题，仍实现了0.6至14.0分的提升。

summary: Recent progress on contrastive audio-language models can be attributed mainly to the scale and quality of their training data. Larger training datasets expose models to a broader range of sounds and corresponding audio captions. To exploit this, we collect 1.48 billion audio samples from academic datasets, internet datasets, web collections, Common Crawl, and YouTube, and process them with a multi-stage curation pipeline. Furthermore, we generate short and long captions for samples in our corpus that lack them. We use our dataset to study the scaling behavior of contrastive audio-language models based on the NaFlex architecture for the audio encoder. Our experiments identify trade-offs between model size and training data for a given compute budget. Moreover, our resulting models, CLAP2, outperform prior audio-text models of comparable size on the MAEB and HEAR benchmarks. We release our dataset, captions, model checkpoints, and code.
title: LAION-Audio-XL: A Web-Scale Corpus and Scaling Studies for Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining

title_translated: LAION-Audio-XL：用于对比语言-音频预训练的大规模语料库与缩放研究
summary_translated: 近期对比音频-语言模型的进步主要归因于训练数据的规模与质量。更大的训练数据集使模型接触到更广泛的音效及其对应的音频描述。为此，我们从学术数据集、互联网数据集、网络集合、Common Crawl和YouTube收集了14.8亿个音频样本，并通过多阶段筛选流程进行处理。此外，我们为原始语料库中缺乏描述的样本生成了短篇和长篇描述。利用该数据集，我们基于NaFlex架构对音频编码器的对比音频-语言模型进行了缩放行为研究。实验揭示了在给定计算预算下，模型规模与训练数据之间的权衡关系。此外，我们得到的CLAP2模型在MAEB和HEAR基准测试中表现优于同等规模的先前音频-文本模型。我们公开发布该数据集、描述、模型检查点及代码。

summary: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.
title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge

title_translated: FinCutBench：衡量LLM金融知识时间边界的持续更新基准
summary_translated: 在金融回测及其他时点任务中，外部输入可通过日期限制，但模型参数可能保留后期披露的金融事实，从而引入参数型前瞻偏差。我们提出FinCutBench，一个持续每月更新的金融知识基准，用于测量固定模型的金融知识在日历时间上的延伸范围。当前数据集包含9,000道中英文四选一多项选择题，覆盖2023年1月至2026年9月期间的中国与美国市场，涵盖四类金融信息。我们通过估算测试事实公开的大致月份，构建每月知识轮廓。在轮廓通过下降检验和拐点检测后，我们将FinCut边界定义为拟合轮廓首次达到最低水平的月份，并报告在重采样下的估计日期稳定性。不同模型的边界日期与定位精度存在差异。使用独立测量的过渡起点和边界作为下游样本分组的固定参考，我们发现部分模型在美国资产排名和盈利回忆任务中，边界之后出现明显相对下降；而中国市场的排名估计在不同模型间存在差异，且所有八个披露周期配对的预测误差比较的未校正p值均高于0.10。因此，FinCut边界为时点金融评估中参数知识的时间范围提供了实证参考，支持评估窗口的选择与结果解释。

summary: Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors.   Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks.   Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision.   Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.
title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification

title_translated: 保障放射科工作流中的代理型AI：基于规则与大语言模型的验证多模型评估
summary_translated: 目的：估算使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）代理在模拟放射科文档记录中，记录临床相关错误或无依据信息的频率，以及在每项操作前应用防护措施能减少多少此类错误。材料与方法：本模拟研究（2026年10月）包含48个合成的、经放射科医生审阅的基础场景，涵盖发现沟通、肿瘤委员会准备及随访管理。其中43个场景还包含误导性信息变体（共91个变体）。六种LLM代理（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、GLM-5.3、MiniMax M3、Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B）在仅允许权限、确定性规则、以及规则加本地运行的LLM检查器三种条件下完成每个变体（共1638个实验回合）。主要结局指标为每回合至少发生一次高严重性违规。按代理层面估算风险差异，并探索性地合并各代理进行汇总分析，同时考察文档访问与操作阻断情况。结果：仅允许权限时，19.4%的回合出现高严重性违规（各代理平均值为7.3%-27.1%）；采用规则后降至16.7%（降低2.8个百分点；95%置信区间：-6.1, 0.5）；加入LLM检查器后进一步降至13.2%（降低6.2个百分点；95%置信区间：-9.5, -3.0）。在规则基础上添加LLM检查器带来额外-3.5个百分点的改善（95%置信区间：-6.3, -0.7）。各代理间未检测到显著差异（P = .43），任务成功率未明显下降。在误导性变体中，无论是否存在错误，代理在83%的回合中打开了被篡改的文档，且58%的错误陈述引用了该文档。大多数被阻断的操作（64%-68%）本不会导致违规，被退回修改。结论：分层防护措施虽减少了高严重性错误，但未能完全防止。在误导信息后的错误反映的是误判而非遗漏信息。

summary: User plane function (UPF) selection in 5G networks is an active area of research, with various limited approaches proposed to enhance network efficiency and manage resources effectively. In this paper, we address this gap in the related literature by proposing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) UPF selection method that utilizes a dynamic, multi-objective reward function and validating it on a real-world 5G emulation platform. The proposed method is based on the large language models' (LLMs) translation of network operator intents and the network data analytics function (NWDAF) abnormality alerts. The experimental results validated in the real-world experimental setup demonstrate that our dynamic DRL solution achieves an effective balance between latency, power consumption, and traffic distribution, outperforming the heuristic baselines and fixed DRL by 16.89%. These findings highlight the real-world applicability of our approach for dynamic, intent-driven UPF selection.
title: LLM-based Multi-Criteria Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Efficient 5G UPF Selection
comment: Accepted at IEEE Globecom 2026 CSM
title_translated: 基于大语言模型的多准则深度强化学习用于动态高效的5G用户面功能选择
summary_translated: 5G网络中的用户面功能（UPF）选择是当前研究的热点，已有多种方法被提出以提升网络效率并有效管理资源。本文通过提出一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的UPF选择方法，利用动态多目标奖励函数，并在真实5G仿真平台上进行验证，填补了该领域研究的空白。所提方法基于大语言模型（LLMs）对网络运营商意图的翻译以及网络数据分析功能（NWDAF）的异常警报。实验结果在真实实验环境中得到验证，表明我们的动态DRL解决方案在延迟、功耗和流量分布之间实现了有效平衡，相比启发式基线和固定DRL提升了16.89%。这些发现突显了本方法在动态、意图驱动的UPF选择中的实际应用价值。

summary: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.
title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces

title_translated: 冻结权重下的智能体自我改进：失败痕迹的附加价值与局限性
summary_translated: 我们评估了AI智能体的辅助笔记（即围绕其模型的记录）是否能从智能体的失败痕迹中学习，而不仅仅是那些从未见过这些痕迹的匹配搜索。结果表明，虽然可以学习，但效果不如表面看起来那么显著。我们测试了一个参数量为90亿的开放模型，其权重固定；一个更大的教师模型负责撰写笔记。在生成客户服务决策任务中，当两个笔记撰写者都知晓目标规则时，基于智能体错误的笔记比仅使用相同流程但隐藏错误信息的笔记提高了4.0个百分点的准确率。仅通过尝试并保留得分更高的笔记这一过程，就达到了总提升量的约60%。在完整的客户服务对话中，同样的笔记并未显示出明显改进。此外，严格筛选单个教学案例后，仅识别出两个客户服务案例（仍在等待新数据测试），以及一个未见智能体错误的工具使用案例，该案例在新的工具使用任务上也未表现出提升。一个无程序的中立笔记反而表现优于学习到的教学案例（探索性）。盲审评估发现240个工具使用测试项中有146个存在缺陷。

summary: The June 2025 outage in the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) collection pipeline left a gap in the Global Knowledge Graph (GKG), interrupting article-level news metadata used in downstream research. ReGKG-2025 is an archive-derived sample of 281,620 reconstructed article records covering all 1,665 missing 15-minute batches. Articles were recovered from Common Crawl and the Wayback Machine using source quotas estimated from surrounding native GKG data. Text was screened and normalized, non-English bodies were translated, and flagged records were manually reviewed. Eligible articles were converted to the 27-column GKG 2.1 layout. The versioned package includes record-level provenance, archive replay and WARC locators, source summaries, source-by-day calibration weights, and the complete manual decision journal. The sample reaches about 14% of modeled native volume and represents sources accounting for 84% of selected reference record mass. In an intact-week test, 41% of recovered articles matched native GKG records; field agreement on matched pairs is close to the processor baseline (tone MAE 1.69). The dataset supports retrospective content analysis and source-level aggregates; its tone and theme distributions differ from native GKG, and it does not support exhaustive counts. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964265.
title: ReGKG-2025: A GKG-Compatible Reconstruction of the GDELT Global Knowledge Graph for the Missing Period of 14 June to 2 July 2025

title_translated: ReGKG-2025：针对2025年6月14日至7月2日缺失期的GDELT全球知识图谱重建（兼容GKG版本）
summary_translated: 2025年6月GDELT事件、语言与情绪数据库收集管道中断，导致全球知识图谱（GKG）出现数据缺口，影响了下游研究中使用的文章级新闻元数据。ReGKG-2025是一个基于存档的数据样本，包含281,620条重构的文章记录，覆盖全部1,665个缺失的15分钟数据批次。文章通过Common Crawl和Wayback Machine恢复，源数据配额根据邻近原生GKG数据估算。文本经过筛选与标准化处理，非英文内容完成翻译，可疑记录进行了人工审核。符合条件的文章被转换为27列的GKG 2.1格式。该版本包包含记录级溯源信息、存档回放与WARC定位器、源摘要、按日校准权重及完整的人工决策日志。该样本达到模拟原生数据量的约14%，代表了占选定参考记录总量84%的来源。在完整周的测试中，41%的恢复文章与原生GKG记录匹配；匹配对在字段一致性上接近处理器基准（情感MAE为1.69）。该数据集支持回顾性内容分析和源级别聚合，其情感与主题分布与原生GKG存在差异，不支持全面计数。

summary: Clinical speech is increasingly used for disease screening and clinical assessment, but directly distributing speech recordings poses privacy risks because they contain both speaker-identifying voiceprints and sensitive spoken content. Existing speech anonymisation approaches are primarily developed for general speech applications or task-specific clinical speech and overlook that different clinical tasks rely on distinct speech characteristics, necessitating task-adaptive anonymisation strategies to protect patient privacy while preserving clinical utility. Here we introduce CASA, a clinically adaptive speech anonymisation agent that transforms anonymisation from a fixed processing procedure into a task-guided optimisation process, dynamically tailoring voiceprint and content anonymisation to task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements. Through recursive self-improvement (RSI), CASA iteratively evaluates and refines anonymisation strategies against task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements, while learning from these outcomes to guide more efficient planning in subsequent clinical tasks. CASA is validated across 14 clinical tasks encompassing five languages, diverse elicitation paradigms, and mental health, cognitive and voice disorders. CASA preserved disease-related classification performance while meeting speaker-anonymisation requirements across all clinical tasks, versus only 8/14 for the strongest fixed method. Assessments of resistance to speaker re-identification by external attackers and identification and redaction of sensitive personal information in clinical speech further demonstrated CASA's dual protection of speaker identity and sensitive spoken content. Clinical expert assessments further supported the preservation of clinically relevant information and the acceptability of anonymised speech for controlled research sharing.
title: Task-adaptive anonymisation enables privacy-preserving sharing of clinical speech data
title_translated: 任务自适应匿名化实现临床语音数据的隐私保护共享
summary_translated: 临床语音在疾病筛查和临床评估中的应用日益广泛，但直接分发语音录音存在隐私风险，因其既包含可识别说话人身份的声纹特征，又包含敏感口语内容。现有语音匿名化方法主要针对通用语音或特定临床任务开发，忽略了不同临床任务依赖不同的语音特征，因此需要采用任务自适应的匿名化策略，在保护患者隐私的同时保留临床效用。本文提出CASA——一种临床自适应语音匿名化智能体，将匿名化从固定处理流程转变为任务引导的优化过程，动态调整声纹和内容匿名化以满足特定任务的隐私与临床效用需求。通过递归自我改进（RSI），CASA在每次任务中迭代评估并优化匿名化策略，同时从结果中学习以指导后续任务更高效的规划。CASA在涵盖五种语言、多样采集范式以及精神健康、认知和语音障碍等14项临床任务中进行了验证。结果显示，CASA在所有任务中均保持了疾病相关分类性能并满足说话人匿名要求，而最强的固定方法仅在8/14项任务中达标。对外部攻击者重识别说话人的抵抗能力评估，以及对临床语音中敏感个人信息的识别与删除评估，进一步证明了CASA对说话人身份和敏感内容的双重保护。临床专家评估也支持匿名化语音保留了临床相关信息，并适合受控研究共享。

summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.
title: TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization
title_translated: TLRS-DPO：用于更好直接偏好优化的词元级风险评分
summary_translated: 直接偏好优化（DPO）是一种简单且广泛应用的大型语言模型（LLM）对齐方法，作为RLHF的替代方案，但其序列级目标无法精确定位或抑制原本可接受响应中导致其不安全或不可取的局部模式。我们提出TLRS-DPO（用于更好直接偏好优化的词元级风险评分），在保持完全离线和基于参考的前提下，引入细粒度的词元级控制机制。TLRS-DPO引入了一种词元级鲁棒补偿项，将拒绝响应上的策略-参考对数比率转化为局部风险评分；采用类课程调度机制，训练过程中逐步增强该补偿强度；并设计了风险自适应筛选机制，仅对高风险词元施加惩罚，而非整个序列。该设计弥合了序列级偏好拟合与词元级行为控制之间的差距，可作为标准DPO训练器的即插即用式修改。实证结果表明，相较于强基线DPO方法，TLRS-DPO在几乎不影响帮助性的前提下，显著提升了对齐质量与安全相关行为。

summary: Activation sparsity can reduce FFN weight traffic during single-user LLM decoding, but active channels must be identified early enough to avoid fetching unused weights. In pretrained SwiGLU models, training-free routing with the native gate performs substantially worse than routing with the up activation at high sparsity. We show that this ordering reverses after sparsity-aware training. Based on this insight, we introduce SGA-Sparse, which converts pretrained SwiGLU LLMs into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by training the existing gate projection directly as a top-k router. SGA-Sparse updates all model parameters end-to-end while preserving the original SwiGLU activation and introducing no auxiliary router parameters. After approximately 30B training tokens, LLaMA models from 1B to 8B achieve uniform per-token 75-85% FFN channel sparsity while remaining within 0.2-2.7 pp of their original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy. Because post-training quantization degrades sparsity-trained checkpoints, we further study two complementary quantization-aware training (QAT) recipes: continued-QAT largely recovers performance at 4-bit weight quantization, while joint-QAT performs better for the more aggressive sub-4-bit target. To compare activation sparsity with dense low-bit quantization, we translate the sparsity-induced reduction in weight traffic into an equivalent bit-width. Under this unified weight-traffic metric, our 2.5- and 1.5-bit-equivalent models establish a new accuracy-traffic Pareto frontier: the 2.5-bit-equivalent models match dense 3-bit QAT accuracy, while the 1.5-bit-equivalent models approach dense 2-bit models and outperform dense ternary models by 1.3 pp on average. These results establish native-gate training as a practical approach for combining high FFN sparsity with low-bit weights.
title: SGA-Sparse: Training Native SwiGLU Gates for Activation-Sparse and Low-Bit LLMs
title_translated: SGA-Sparse：为激活稀疏和低比特大语言模型训练原生SwiGLU门控
summary_translated: 激活稀疏性可以在单用户大语言模型解码过程中减少前馈网络的权重传输量，但必须尽早识别出活跃通道以避免加载未使用的权重。在预训练的SwiGLU模型中，使用原生门控进行无训练路由在高稀疏度下表现明显劣于使用上行激活进行路由。我们发现，在经过稀疏感知训练后，这种排序会发生反转。基于这一洞察，我们提出了SGA-Sparse，通过直接训练现有门控投影作为top-k路由器，将预训练的SwiGLU大语言模型转换为固定预算的激活稀疏模型。SGA-Sparse在保持原始SwiGLU激活机制的同时，无需引入辅助路由器参数，实现了全模型端到端更新。经过约300亿训练标记后，1B至8B规模的LLaMA模型实现了每token 75%-85%的FFN通道稀疏度，同时在平均零样本准确率上仅比原始稠密检查点下降0.2-2.7个百分点。由于后训练量化会损害稀疏训练检查点的性能，我们进一步研究了两种互补的量化感知训练（QAT）方法：持续QAT在4比特权重量化下基本恢复性能，而联合QAT在更激进的亚4比特目标下表现更优。为了比较激活稀疏性与稠密低比特量化，我们将稀疏性带来的权重流量减少转化为等效比特宽度。在此统一的权重流量指标下，我们的2.5比特和1.5比特等效模型建立了新的精度-流量帕累托前沿：2.5比特等效模型达到稠密3比特QAT的精度水平，而1.5比特等效模型接近稠密2比特模型，并在平均上优于稠密三值模型1.3个百分点。这些结果确立了原生门控训练作为一种结合高FFN稀疏性与低比特权重的实用方法。

summary: Historical social simulation faces a fundamental reproducibility challenge: the stochastic nature of large language models (LLMs) introduces a digital butterfly effect that prevents exact replication across multi-turn runs. Furthermore, the inability to control low-level server parameters in commercial LLM hosting environments severely limits reproducibility. To overcome this opacity, we present a deterministic multi-agent framework coupling LLMs to an Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) pipeline grounded in Theory of Mind (ToM) and Cognitive Archaeology, and validate exact artifact identity within local, pinned execution environments using SHA-256 hashing. Run locally at temperature zero with clean per-call model reloads, the system injects differentiated cognitive states per turn through dissonance-driven behavioural modes and gated internal voices. Evaluating seven model configurations spanning 4B to 31B parameters against an ablated baseline reveals clear operational boundaries. Small models ($\leq$8B) suffer from context capacity overload, producing repetitive, specular dialogue loops. However, at $\geq$12B parameters, the ABM scaffolding breaks the monotonous response patterns seen in ablation. Crucially, these scaffolded models exhibit spontaneous diegetic expansion: they coherently expand scenario lore through tactically motivated, anachronism-free details rather than escalating into aggression. By resisting the structural pull toward premature scene closure, scaffolded sessions sustain an open terminal Narrative Vector ($V_N = \mathrm{Open}$ in 12/21 overall; 9/9 in official $\geq$12B configurations) whereas unscaffolded ablation never does (0/21). This framework provides a transparent, auditable benchmark architecture for virtual archaeology, with the full pipeline released as open-source software to enable independent replication.
title: Deterministic Narrative Gravity: Bridging Theory of Mind and Historical Simulation through ABM-LLM Architectures
comment: 28 pages, 2 figures. To appear in the Journal of Computer Applications in Archaeology. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 确定性叙事引力：通过ABM-LLM架构连接心智理论与历史模拟
summary_translated: 历史社会模拟面临一个根本性的可复现性挑战：大型语言模型（LLMs）的随机性引入了数字蝴蝶效应，导致多轮运行之间无法精确复制。此外，商业LLM托管环境中无法控制底层服务器参数，严重限制了可复现性。为克服这种不透明性，我们提出了一种确定性的多智能体框架，将LLMs与基于心智理论（ToM）和认知考古学的基于代理建模（ABM）流程相结合，并在本地固定执行环境中利用SHA-256哈希验证完全一致的产物身份。在温度为零的本地运行环境下，通过每调用一次即重新加载模型，系统通过矛盾驱动的行为模式和受控的内部声音注入每轮不同的认知状态。对涵盖4B至31B参数的七种模型配置与消融基线进行评估，揭示了清晰的操作边界。小模型（≤8B）因上下文容量过载，产生重复、镜像式的对话循环。然而，在≥12B参数时，ABM结构打破了消融实验中单调的响应模式。关键的是，这些有结构支撑的模型表现出自发的情节扩展：它们通过战术驱动、无时代错乱的细节，连贯地扩展场景背景，而非演变为攻击性行为。通过抵抗过早场景闭合的结构性倾向，有结构支撑的会话维持了开放的终端叙事向量（V_N = Open 在21次中的12次；在官方≥12B配置中9/9），而无结构支撑的消融实验从未实现（0/21）。该框架为虚拟考古学提供了一个透明、可审计的基准架构，整个流程已开源，以支持独立复现。

summary: Relevant evidence in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) collections may be distributed across passages in different parts of a work, including verses, translations, and commentaries. Locating it requires matching natural-language questions and partially remembered verse fragments to source passages. We present Dhara, a retrieval engine combining hybrid search, chapter- and book-level Entity Notes (EN), Fuzzy Verse Retrieval (FVR), and neural reranking. Five comparisons on the 325 questions in Dhara Bench examine retrieval representations against BM25, EN's contribution, reranker quality and computation time, FVR, and Gemini. BGE-M3 single-vector retrieval exceeds BM25 in nDCG@10, Recall@20, and MRR@20 across all categories. Its scores are broadly comparable to ColBERTv2, with mean retrieval times of 0.108 s and 0.962 s under the same hardware configuration and a smaller memory footprint for chunk storage on disk. Adding EN to a direct branch with a matched candidate count improves nDCG@10 in all twelve categories with Qwen and ten with BGE; the combined ranking is capped at the same candidate count. Qwen improves nDCG@10, Precision@5, and MRR@20 over BGE in every category, at approximately 6.72 times the overall estimated serial computation time. FVR increases Verse-category nDCG@10 by approximately 20 percentage points with either reranker. Gemini is evaluated after source mapping and manual review with relevance annotations visible. The Qwen pipeline with EN and FVR has higher Recall@20 than Gemini in ten categories and stronger complete-evidence retrieval in Multi-hop questions, while Gemini retains early-relevance advantages in several categories. The results inform retrieval choices according to evidence requirements and resource budgets.
title: Dhara: Evidence-Oriented Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
comment: 19 pages. Supplementary material (24 pages) is provided as a separate ancillary PDF
title_translated: Dhara：面向印度知识体系的证据导向检索
summary_translated: 印度知识体系（IKS）文献中的相关证据可能分散在作品的不同部分，包括诗句、译文和注释中。定位这些证据需要将自然语言问题和部分记忆的诗句片段与源文本匹配。我们提出了Dhara，一种结合混合搜索、章节与书籍级实体笔记（EN）、模糊诗句检索（FVR）和神经重排的检索引擎。在包含325个问题的Dhara Bench上进行了五项对比实验，考察了检索表示与BM25的对比、EN的贡献、重排器质量与计算时间、FVR以及Gemini的表现。BGE-M3单向量检索在所有类别中均优于BM25，nDCG@10、Recall@20和MRR@20指标均有提升。其性能大致相当于ColBERTv2，在相同硬件配置下的平均检索时间分别为0.108秒和0.962秒，且在磁盘上存储块时具有更小的内存占用。在直接分支中加入EN并设定候选数量后，所有十二个类别中nDCG@10均得到提升（Qwen提升12类，BGE提升10类），组合排名受限于相同的候选数量。Qwen在每个类别中均优于BGE，nDCG@10、Precision@5和MRR@20均有提升，但整体估计串行计算时间约为BGE的6.72倍。FVR使任一重排器下的诗句类别nDCG@10提升约20个百分点。Gemini在源映射和人工审查后评估，相关性标注可见。Qwen管道结合EN与FVR在十个类别中Recall@20高于Gemini，且在多跳问题中具备更强的完整证据检索能力，而Gemini在若干类别中仍保持早期相关性优势。结果根据证据需求和资源预算为检索策略选择提供了依据。

summary: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.
title: When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets
title_translated: 邻近专家何时可组合？神经丛林中的跨任务模型融合
summary_translated: 围绕共享检查点的随机扰动可生成不同任务的专家，但共享起源并不保证其收益在组合后仍能保留。我们提出了用于联合基础相对保留的专家对选择方法，以严格联合成功和最差任务增益（考虑无条件回避）为衡量标准。通过精确的有限差分分解和任意小的正交反例，说明仅靠接近性和正交性是不够的。我们通过质量约束的谱选择方法实例化该公式，这是一种固定预算框架，结合跨任务筛选、逐层配对几何、独立验证和基础回退机制。在六个检查点、21个任务对和五个独立扰动池上的实验表明，该方法在整个过程中均优于Top-1平均法，并在六检查点中的四个上领先于四种方法的模型规模比较。对于至少15亿参数的五个模型，匹配的质量仅、全局余弦和谱排名分别达到49.1%、50.5%和53.1%的联合成功率。在此匹配协议下，谱选择器还实现了最高的最差任务增益、弱帕累托率和最低的回归率，平均最差任务增益达+0.61个百分点，17.1%的回归率和13.0%的回避率表明组合性仍为条件性。项目页面：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/。

summary: This study asks what changed in engineering articles after conversational language models became publicly available on November 30, 2022, and develops methods for measuring such change in a field without a uniform abstract index. It assembled 1,839,962 articles published from 2015 to 2025 in 256 engineering journals, tracked twelve measures of wording, style, and article structure, and compared each with the projection of its own pre-2023 trend. Building the monthly series showed that records dated only by year fall on January 1 and create false January peaks unless removed. In abstracts, 31 words associated with language model output appeared 82% more often than projected (55.4 against 27.0 per 10,000 words in 2025), while four control words of the same formal register fell 16%. Words that soften a claim, such as may, fell 13%, words that strengthen one, such as clearly, rose 20%, and long words rose 11%. Author counts, reference lists, page counts, and publication volume stayed within 4% of trend. The change appears in all fourteen subject categories, and false release dates, dropping any one journal or word, and word lists chosen from the data support it. A random sample of 12,866 full texts from the same corpus, including subscription articles and weighted back to it, shows the same words rising 99% in article bodies. Statements disclosing AI writing assistance, measured apart from mentions of language models, went from none to 3.7% in 2025, four in five of them at one publisher. The design is descriptive, not causal.
title: What Changed in Engineering Writing After Generative AI Chat Assistants: Evidence from 1.8 Million Articles

title_translated: 生成式AI聊天助手出现后工程写作发生了什么变化？来自180万篇文章的证据
summary_translated: 本研究探讨自2022年11月30日对话式语言模型公开可用以来，工程类文章发生了哪些变化，并开发了在缺乏统一摘要索引的领域中测量此类变化的方法。研究收集了2015年至2025年间256个工程期刊发表的1,839,962篇文章，追踪了十二项关于措辞、风格和文章结构的指标，并将其与各自2023年前的趋势预测进行比较。构建月度序列显示，仅按年份记录的数据会落在1月1日，若不剔除则会产生虚假的1月峰值。在摘要中，与语言模型输出相关的31个词汇在2025年的使用频率比预测高出82%（每10,000词55.4 vs. 27.0），而同形式注册的四个对照词下降了16%。软化陈述的词汇（如may）下降13%，强化陈述的词汇（如clearly）上升20%，长词使用上升11%。作者人数、参考文献列表、页数和出版量均在趋势的4%以内波动。变化出现在全部十四类主题中，且去除任意一个期刊或词语、使用数据内选取的词表等分析均支持该结论。对同一语料库中12,866篇全文的随机抽样（包括订阅文章并加权回归）显示，这些词汇在文章主体中上升了99%。披露AI写作协助的声明（与提及语言模型分开测量）从零增长至2025年的3.7%，其中四分之五出自单一出版商。该设计为描述性研究，非因果性。

summary: Although hidden-state probes efficiently monitor model operation, it remains unclear whether probes trained on benign tool use remain useful for detecting incorrect actions under adversarial conditions. In this research, we assess this problem from the perspective of operational tool-action correct- ness. we use four AgentDojo suites, four conditions, and three models: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and GLM- 4.6V-Flash (9B). We perform a five-fold, task-grouped out-of-fold (OOF) evaluation for each model. We train step-specific logistic- regression probes only on benign and non-defended trajectories and evaluate them on held-out trajectories for benign, prompt- injection, system-override, and tool-poisoning conditions. We compare our hidden-state probe to mean tool-call-token entropy, negative mean tool-call-token log-probability, and self-consistency uncertainty. The paired tests highlight six significant differences after Holm correction. All of the tests involve Qwen2.5-14B- Instruct under the system-override condition, with all three scalar uncertainty metrics obtaining higher area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and average precision (AP) than the hidden-state probe. These results suggest that benign-trained hidden-state probes should not be assumed to reliably detect operational tool-action errors under adversarial conditions.
title: Do Benign-Trained Hidden-State Probes Detect Tool Errors Under Adversarial Conditions?
title_translated: 良性训练的隐藏状态探测器在对抗条件下能否检测工具错误？
summary_translated: 尽管隐藏状态探测器能高效监控模型运行，但尚不清楚在良性工具使用上训练的探测器在对抗条件下是否仍能有效检测错误操作。本研究从操作工具-动作正确性的角度评估该问题。我们使用四个AgentDojo套件、四种条件及三种模型：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 和 GLM-4.6V-Flash（9B）。对每种模型进行五折、按任务组划分的留外评估（OOF）。仅在良性且未受防护的轨迹上训练特定步骤的逻辑回归探测器，并在保留轨迹上评估其在良性、提示注入、系统覆盖和工具污染条件下的表现。将隐藏状态探测器与平均工具调用标记熵、负平均工具调用标记对数概率以及自一致性不确定性进行比较。配对检验在Holm校正后显示出六处显著差异。所有测试均涉及Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct在系统覆盖条件下的表现，三种标量不确定性指标的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和平均精度（AP）均高于隐藏状态探测器。结果表明，不应假设良性训练的隐藏状态探测器在对抗条件下能可靠检测操作性工具-动作错误。

summary: Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.
title: Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance
title_translated: 任务呈现与执行路径影响大语言模型的数学表现
summary_translated: 数学性能取决于语言模型接收信息的方式、生成文本的使用方式以及答案提交形式。我们通过成对比较，分离了提交要求、草稿复用和候选答案可用性的影响。在65个开发问题上，允许持续推导的指令在390次短输出调用中未能产生任何有效最终答案；而单行提交指令则产生了390个格式有效的输出，其中包含389个可解析的答案。在固定提交协议下，198个初始提交失败的问题中，仅提供问题时有9.09%的情况正确回答，提供问题和草稿时为33.84%，提供候选答案时为46.46%，同时提供两者时为59.60%。在候选答案固定的情况下，草稿增加13.13个百分点；在草稿固定的情况下，候选答案增加25.76个百分点；两种效应在Holm校正后均显著，且在准确率尺度上呈非加性。保留尾部片段的表现优于保留头部片段（平均长度相似），提升10.10个百分点（Holm调整后p=0.027）。第二个完成模型在固定材料上的输入效应方向一致。在可解析初始提交的群体中，当提供先前草稿时，候选答案未增加正确答案；但在无草稿时，候选答案增加了27个百分点。这些结果确立了生成文本的条件价值：一次失败的提交可能留下有用材料，其贡献取决于其他提供的内容和保留的信息。

summary: Low-bit post-training quantization reduces language-model memory but can sharply degrade downstream task accuracy. Calibration usually relies on generic text, but when task-informed data recover accuracy and which quantizers benefit remain poorly understood. We introduce FragCal-DC, which supplements generic text with training documents from task families with low retention of full-precision accuracy in a two-bit scan. We use a two- to four-bit sweep to locate functional regimes and four-seed calibration comparisons to evaluate six data-dependent methods across six dense models (1.7B-8B) and ten tasks. At their lowest tested functional bit widths, iterative SignRound V2 and OmniQuant improve at two bits, whereas single-pass GPTQ and AWQ show small mean responses at three bits. At two bits, SignRound V2 gains 1.83 percentage points in mean ten-task accuracy over generic-text calibration across six models. At 70 billion parameters, GPTQ and SignRound V2 both improve at two bits, with functional generic-calibration baselines. For two-bit SignRound V2, task-level controls show that recovery concentrates on families included in calibration, while incorrect answer designations retain about 90% of the mean accuracy gain. Changes in reconstruction error do not consistently track accuracy gains. These findings support task-informed calibration as a design principle for preserving downstream accuracy in low-bit quantization.
title: When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization

title_translated: 在低于4比特的语言模型量化中，校准数据为何重要？
summary_translated: 低比特后训练量化可减少语言模型内存占用，但可能导致下游任务准确率急剧下降。通常校准依赖通用文本，但何时任务相关数据能恢复准确率，以及哪些量化器受益，仍不明确。我们提出FragCal-DC，通过补充任务家族中全精度准确率保留率较低的训练文档，在两比特扫描中增强通用文本。我们采用二至四比特扫描定位功能区间，并通过四种子校准对比评估六种数据依赖方法在六种密集模型（1.7B–8B）和十个任务上的表现。在最低测试功能比特宽度下，迭代SignRound V2和OmniQuant在两比特时表现优异，而单次遍历的GPTQ和AWQ在三比特时响应微弱。在两比特时，SignRound V2在六个模型上相比通用文本校准平均提升1.83个百分点的十任务准确率。在700亿参数规模下，GPTQ和SignRound V2均在两比特时表现提升，且具备功能性通用校准基线。对于两比特SignRound V2，任务级控制显示恢复集中在校准中包含的任务家族，而错误答案标注保留了约90%的平均准确率提升。重构误差的变化并未一致追踪准确率提升。这些发现支持任务导向校准作为低比特量化中保持下游准确率的设计原则。

summary: Large language model safety evaluations often focus on a compliance-refusal tradeoff: models should refuse unsafe requests without refusing safe ones. We argue that this misses a broader form of prompt-conditioned task selection, where the same request can elicit different behaviors depending on the system prompt. We investigate this using a controlled evaluation crossing eight safety-task prompt families with three clarity levels across HarmBench, XSTest, and IHEval. Holding benchmark items fixed, we evaluate 13 models and use signal detection theory to distinguish two possibilities: whether models become better at telling safe from unsafe requests (discriminability), or simply more willing to refuse (response criterion). We find substantial differences in discriminability across models, but system prompts primarily shift the willingness to refuse, with smaller and less consistent effects on discriminability. Increasing prompt clarity makes models more willing to refuse without reliably improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe requests. Beyond refusal, prompt families also shift responses among six distinct behavioral policies, including clarification and safe help. Together, these findings show that system prompts primarily change how models respond to safety-relevant requests rather than consistently improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe ones.
title: System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety

title_translated: 系统提示对大语言模型安全性的响应偏差影响大于可区分性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的安全评估常聚焦于合规-拒绝权衡：模型应拒绝不安全请求而不拒绝安全请求。我们认为这忽略了更广泛的提示条件任务选择现象，即同一请求在不同系统提示下可能引发不同行为。我们通过受控评估，交叉八类安全任务提示与三个清晰度层级，在HarmBench、XSTest和IHEval基准上进行研究。在固定基准条目下，评估13个模型，并使用信号检测理论区分两种可能性：模型是否变得更擅长区分安全与不安全请求（可区分性），或仅仅是更愿意拒绝（响应标准）。我们发现模型间可区分性存在显著差异，但系统提示主要改变拒绝意愿，对可区分性影响较小且不一致。提高提示清晰度使模型更愿意拒绝，但并未可靠提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力。除拒绝外，提示类别还导致模型在六种不同行为策略之间转移，包括澄清和安全帮助。这些发现表明，系统提示主要改变模型对安全相关请求的响应方式，而非一致提升其区分能力。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in user-facing systems, where jailbreak attacks can bypass safety controls and induce harmful and policy-violating outputs. Recent model-internal detectors use hidden representations, gradients, or internal signals to identify such prompts, but their practical security value depends critically on behavior at low false-positive operating points rather than on area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) alone.   We study two data dependencies that shape this behavior: calibration data, which determine the detection threshold, and reference data, which can influence detector scores. Across four model-internal detectors, four LLMs, and twelve jailbreak families, thresholds calibrated on curated benign prompts frequently fail to preserve their false-positive rate (FPR) budgets on real-user traffic. Recalibration improves false-positive control but reveals substantial family-level coverage gaps, including cases with high AUROC but low true-positive rate (TPR). Causal reference-set interventions show that changing reference composition can substantially alter family-level detection and that improving coverage of one attack family can reduce coverage of others.   These findings show that calibration and reference data are part of a detector's security behavior. We therefore recommend evaluating model-internal jailbreak defenses using realized FPR on deployment-like traffic and per-family TPR at explicit low-FPR operating points, with AUROC used as a complementary ranking metric rather than the primary security measure.
title: Beyond AUROC: Deployment-Aware Evaluation of Model-Internal Jailbreak Detectors
comment: Accepted to the 13th IEEE Special Session on Privacy and Security of Big Data (PSBD 2026), IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)
title_translated: 超越AUROC：面向部署场景的模型内部越狱检测器评估
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地部署于用户交互系统中，越狱攻击可能绕过安全控制，诱导有害或违规输出。近期的模型内部检测器利用隐藏表示、梯度或内部信号识别此类提示，但其实际安全价值关键取决于在低假阳性率操作点的行为，而不仅限于受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。我们研究了两个影响该行为的数据依赖因素：校准数据（决定检测阈值）和参考数据（可能影响检测得分）。在四个模型内部检测器、四个LLMs和十二类越狱攻击家族中，基于精心筛选的良性提示校准的阈值在真实用户流量上频繁无法维持其假阳性率（FPR）预算。重新校准虽改善了假阳性控制，却暴露出显著的家族级覆盖率缺口，包括某些AUROC高但真正阳性率（TPR）低的情况。因果参考集干预表明，改变参考组成可显著改变家族级检测效果，且提升某一攻击家族的覆盖率可能降低其他家族的覆盖率。这些发现表明，校准和参考数据是检测器安全行为的一部分。因此，我们建议评估模型内部越狱防御时，应使用部署类似流量中的实际FPR和显式低FPR操作点下的各家族TPR，而将AUROC作为辅助排序指标，而非主要安全度量标准。

summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG
title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion

title_translated: Lightfoot：基于图检索增强生成的精确、无模型文档删除方法
summary_translated: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）提升了多跳问答性能，但实际部署系统面临两个研究中很少衡量的成本：构建图结构和从图中删除文档。我们提出Lightfoot，一种GraphRAG系统，其中每个实体、链接、事实和同义边都是基于携带段落级溯源信息的逐段提取结果的确定性函数。索引阶段每段仅需一次语言模型调用，检索阶段无需模型调用，删除文档仅为数据库操作且不涉及模型调用。在包含11,402个段落的MuSiQue语料库上，我们验证了删除10%文档后，图结构与重新索引剩余文档的结果完全一致。我们在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA三个数据集上，使用相同的提取、答案生成和嵌入模型，将Lightfoot与HippoRAG 2、LightRAG和fast-graphrag进行对比。结果显示，Lightfoot在所有三个数据集上的索引成本最低，比HippoRAG 2低26-31%，比LightRAG和fast-graphrag低3-6倍。相较于HippoRAG 2，Lightfoot在MuSiQue检索任务上表现更优（recall@5提升2.8点，recall@10提升4.3点，在保留分割集上），在HotpotQA答案准确率上也显著更高（exact match提升7.7点），但在2WikiMultiHopQA上表现较差（recall@2下降3.9点，F1下降8.4点）。相同文档删除操作中，LightRAG耗时2,187次模型调用和3.7小时；而fast-graphrag则无删除路径。代码与逐题结果见：https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

summary: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.
title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback

title_translated: DM-Call：基于决策模型引导的函数调用与累积验证反馈
summary_translated: 可靠的函数调用要求大语言模型（LLMs）选择合适的函数并生成与用户意图一致的参数。然而，语法正确的调用仍可能因函数选择不当或参数不匹配而导致语义错误。本文提出决策模型引导的函数调用框架（DM-Call），结合局部模式验证与独立的决策模型对函数选择和参数正确性进行验证。对于被拒绝的候选方案，DM-Call会累积多次尝试中的验证概率、二元判断和模式错误信息。通过混合反馈表示，将数值概率与语言正确性标签相结合，指导迭代优化过程，无需执行外部工具。在BFCL和API-Bank（首次调用）上的广泛评估表明，DM-Call在适度增加成本的前提下，显著提升了函数调用的准确性。

summary: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.
title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training

title_translated: 删除权重在大语言模型后训练中的惊人有效性
summary_translated: 预训练的大语言模型（LLM）需要改变多少部分才能获得新能力？我们发现，仅将少于0.05%的权重置零，无需其他修改，即可在三种LLM后训练范式中达到与全量微调（FFT）相当的效果：基于可验证奖励的强化学习、监督微调以及在线策略蒸馏。我们的方法称为“删除调优”（Deletion Tuning），通过学习Transformer块门控投影上的二值掩码来实现。该方法具有两项实际优势：训练得到的掩码比对应FFT检查点小数百至数千倍，且遗忘程度远低于FFT、LoRA和随机稀疏微调，有效缓解持续学习中的核心挑战。在强化学习场景下，其前任务准确率保持接近基础水平，而FFT、LoRA和随机稀疏微调的准确率最高下降5.4分。为理解为何仅掩码即可奏效，我们利用稳定秩、谱漂移和主权重重叠等指标分析了强化学习下的权重变化几何特性。相比LoRA和随机稀疏微调，删除调优在三项指标上均最接近全量微调。

summary: Individuals experiencing suicidal ideation (SI) or psychological distress may disclose their social identities when seeking support from LLMs. Attending to identity-related stressors can be important for providing contextually appropriate and empathetic support. However, disclosing an identity does not necessarily mean that it is a cause of distress. In this work, we audit how LLMs interpret distress through disclosed identities. Using paired counterfactual interventions, we evaluate six LLMs across two SI and distress datasets, 16 identity and control conditions, and two prompting protocols. Our findings suggest that models can transform identity disclosures into explanatory narratives, attributing distress to presumed identity-related adversity. These assumptions frequently appear within otherwise empathetic responses, particularly when marginalized identities are disclosed. We contextualize our findings through the lens of compassionate othering to characterize these patterns as a form of harm in which empathetic responses impose identity-linked assumptions on individual suffering. These responses can misrepresent individuals' experiences by treating their identities as explanations for distress without supporting evidence. Our findings highlight the need to mitigate these harms by grounding interpretations of distress in individuals' disclosures and avoiding unsupported identity-linked assumptions.
title: CompAIssionate Other: Identity Assumptions in LLM Responses to Distress
title_translated: 共情他者：大语言模型对痛苦回应中的身份假设
summary_translated: 经历自杀意念（SI）或心理困扰的个体在向大语言模型寻求支持时，可能会披露其社会身份。关注与身份相关的压力源对于提供情境适切且富有同理心的支持至关重要。然而，披露身份并不意味着该身份就是痛苦的原因。本文审计了大语言模型如何通过披露的身份来解读痛苦。我们采用成对反事实干预，在两个SI与心理困扰数据集、16种身份与对照条件及两种提示协议下评估六种大语言模型。研究发现，模型常将身份披露转化为解释性叙事，将痛苦归因于假定的身份相关困境。这些假设频繁出现在本已具同理心的回应中，尤其当边缘化身份被披露时更为明显。我们通过‘共情他者’的视角来阐释这些现象，将其视为一种伤害形式——即在表达同理心的同时，强加了与身份相关的假设于个体的痛苦之上。此类回应可能通过未经证实地将身份作为痛苦原因，歪曲个体的真实体验。研究强调必须通过基于个体披露的内容来理解痛苦，并避免做出无依据的身份关联假设，以减轻此类危害。

summary: Under strict privacy regulations in the clinical domain, de-identification is necessary to enable the use of clinical data such as for natural language processing. However, we currently lack sophisticated ways to tell which de-identification models actually are suitable. Specifically, we need benchmarks that are challenging, diverse, and clinically plausible, all while ensuring label correctness. To this end, we present SPARCLING, an LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic discharge letters with character-exact PHI span annotations. Our pipeline combines structured attribute sampling, template generation, and red teaming to obtain diverse PHI-labeled discharge letters. In our experiments, we demonstrate this superior content diversity over existing public datasets. Further, we show SPARCLING's downstream utility as a benchmark to uncover failure modes of de-identifiers in the German clinical domain. Finally, our experiments show that training on our synthetic data can yield more capable de-identifiers than training on the scarce public data alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator.
title: Generating Diverse and Verified Synthetic Clinical Notes with Labels by Construction
