title_translated: 通过构建方式生成多样且经验证的带标签合成临床笔记
summary_translated: 在临床领域严格的隐私法规下，去标识化是使临床数据（如用于自然语言处理）得以使用的必要步骤。然而，目前缺乏有效手段判断哪些去标识化模型真正适用。具体而言，我们需要具备挑战性、多样性且临床上合理的基准，同时确保标签的准确性。为此，我们提出了SPARCLING，一个基于大语言模型的流水线，用于生成带有字符级精确隐私信息（PHI）标注的合成出院记录。该流水线结合结构化属性采样、模板生成与红队测试，以获得多样化的带PHI标注的出院记录。实验表明，其内容多样性优于现有公开数据集。此外，我们展示了SPARCLING在德国临床领域作为基准的下游应用价值，能够揭示去标识化工具的失效模式。最后，实验还表明，使用我们的合成数据训练出的去标识化模型，其性能优于仅使用稀缺公开数据训练的模型。代码已开源：https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) often do not produce calibrated uncertainty estimates for their answers. We propose CAELUM, a framework that builds semantic prediction sets while separating aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty. CAELUM samples answers using an ensemble of clarification prompts, clusters them by semantic equivalence, and estimates the aleatoric and epistemic components via kernel-based von Neumann entropy before calibrating nonconformity scores with split conformal prediction. We use a weight $w_λ(x)=1+U_{\mathrm{ale}}(x)+λ\,U_{\mathrm{epi}}(x)$ to control for the contribution of the epistemic uncertainty of each instance and fit a coefficient $λ^\star$ to minimize prediction set size. When the objective is nonflat and selection is stable across splits, $λ^\star$ could be a diagnostic, where large values may indicate epistemic dominance (retrieve, abstain) and $λ^\star\to 0$ aleatoric dominance (clarify). For individual queries, a log ratio $R(x)$ compares the weighted epistemic component with the aleatoric component. Theoretically, we demonstrate that the coverage is capped by matchability, the fraction of items whose reference answer appears in any sampled cluster. Empirically, this matchability can be predicted from the original question features using a lightweight classifier. We use those predictions to define a stratum and derive a conformal coverage bound within it. Across 30 LLM and dataset combinations (4-32B), mean coverage is 0.74 in the learned stratum versus 0.65 overall, averaged over the 78 evaluations using the learned classifier. Project page: https://unco3892.github.io/caelum/
title: Matchability-Aware Conformal Prediction for Open-Ended Language Model Generation

title_translated: 面向开放式语言模型生成的可匹配性感知置信预测
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常无法对其答案提供校准的不确定性估计。我们提出了CAELUM框架，该框架在分离随机不确定性与认知不确定性的同时构建语义预测集。CAELUM通过集成澄清提示采样答案，根据语义等价性对答案进行聚类，并利用基于核函数的冯·诺伊曼熵估计随机和认知分量，再通过分割置信预测校准非符合性分数。我们使用权重 $w_λ(x)=1+U_{\mathrm{ale}}(x)+λ\,U_{\mathrm{epi}}(x)$ 控制每个实例的认知不确定性贡献，并拟合系数 $λ^\star$ 以最小化预测集大小。当目标函数非平坦且选择在不同分割中稳定时，$λ^\star$ 可作为诊断指标：较大值可能表明认知主导（检索或放弃），而 $λ^\star\to 0$ 则表示随机主导（澄清）。对于单个查询，对数比值 $R(x)$ 比较加权认知分量与随机分量。理论上，我们证明了覆盖率受可匹配性限制，即参考答案出现在任意采样聚类中的项目比例。实证上，该可匹配性可通过原始问题特征用轻量级分类器预测。我们利用这些预测定义分层，并推导出该分层内的置信覆盖边界。在30种LLM与数据集组合（4-32B）中，使用学习到的分类器进行评估，平均覆盖率为0.74（学习分层内）对比整体0.65，共78次评估。项目页面：https://unco3892.github.io/caelum/

summary: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.
title: Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind

title_translated: 感知而非推理限制了视觉心智理论
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型在基于文本的错误信念测试中达到接近人类水平，但一旦问题以视觉方式呈现，其表现下降超过二十个百分点。主流诊断认为是概念性缺陷，主张引入新的信念推理模块。我们提出，主要瓶颈在于感知：并非模型无法推理，而是无法正确感知。我们设计了一种五条件分离协议，在保持推理任务不变的前提下，从纯视觉到纯文本逐步改变感知保真度，并通过感知贡献率量化每种保真度对视觉到文本差距的缩小程度。我们在两类场景中进行了测试：海德-西梅尔传统的抽象二维面板，以及来自MuMA-ToM和MindPower的自然三维游戏场景。评估涵盖七种VLM，约15.9万次API调用。真实标签支架在所有设置中显著缩小差距，在抽象面板和MuMA-ToM上甚至达到或超过纯文本推理表现；而由自动解析器构建的支架，包括前沿VLM，均未能成功。在纯视觉条件下最常见的错误是‘现实偏差’，占错误信念失败的60%。模型报告物体实际位置，而非缺席代理所相信的位置。这指向一个感知前端失效的问题，即无法追踪每个时刻哪些代理在场。在评估协议下，结构化视觉场景状态提取而非信念推断，成为视觉心智理论的主要瓶颈。

summary: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans highly heterogeneous input regimes, with sampling rates from approximately $10^{-5}$ to $10^6$ Hz, sequence lengths from $10^1$ to $10^6$ samples, and both single- and multi-channel inputs. Evaluations of current open-source and proprietary Audio LLMs (ALLMs) reveal limited zero-shot transfer to machine hearing. Supervised adaptation on machine-hearing data alone does not close this gap, suggesting that the challenge extends beyond data exposure to a systematic mismatch between existing audio front ends and machine-hearing inputs. To address this mismatch, we introduce MachEar, a lightweight encoder extension that complements the pretrained Audio LLM for machine-hearing inputs. The results show that MachEar equips a pretrained Audio LLM with stronger machine-hearing capabilities while largely preserving its existing audio understanding performance.
title: Machine Hearing: Can Audio LLMs Generalize Beyond Human Auditory Perception?

title_translated: 机器听觉：音频大模型能否超越人类听觉感知？
summary_translated: 多模态大模型在感知物理世界方面取得了显著进展，但其感知范围仍主要以人类为中心，聚焦于人类能直接看到或听到的内容。这一进展引发了超越人类感知极限的可能性，例如将听觉扩展至人耳无法听见的声音。更广泛地说，物理世界充满波、振动和振荡，其中只有一小部分能被人类直接听见。这促使我们探索将多模态大模型拓展为更广泛的‘机器听觉’形式，但该方向仍基本未被充分研究。为探究此方向，我们引入了机器听觉基准（MHB），包含13个任务和7个领域的6,128个实例。MHB涵盖高度异构的输入模式，采样率从约 $10^{-5}$ 到 $10^6$ Hz，序列长度从 $10^1$ 到 $10^6$ 个样本，支持单通道与多通道输入。对当前开源及专有音频大模型（ALLMs）的评估显示，其在机器听觉任务上的零样本迁移能力有限。仅在机器听觉数据上进行监督微调也无法弥合这一差距，表明挑战不仅源于数据暴露，更在于现有音频前端与机器听觉输入之间存在系统性不匹配。为解决此问题，我们引入MachEar，一种轻量级编码器扩展，用于补充预训练音频大模型以处理机器听觉输入。结果表明，MachEar使预训练音频大模型具备更强的机器听觉能力，同时基本保留其原有音频理解性能。

summary: Diarization-conditioned target-speaker ASR (TS-ASR), in particular Diarization-conditioned Whisper (DiCoW), is an accurate and data-efficient approach to multi-talker transcription. It has, however, three structural limitations: the model transcribes each speaker independently, operates on short (30 s) windows, and optimizes its diarization and TS-ASR components separately. We address the first two. We integrate the diarization conditioning into a longform Parakeet backbone (DiCoP) and add cross-speaker attention, which lets the model attend across the speaker dimension so that speakers are no longer decoded in isolation, and an STNO mask refiner that re-estimates the diarization-derived conditioning. As conversational data with genuine multi-speaker interaction is scarce, we scale training with a pseudo-labeling pipeline that mines 5.4k hours of in-the-wild multi-speaker audio from YODAS2. Combining these with synthetic and real data yields state-of-the-art results across several meeting benchmarks. We open-source the resulting models, DiCoP and Pandemonium, and the pseudo-labeled data.
title: Pandemonium: Longform Target-Speaker Speech Recognition with Cross-Speaker Interactions
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027
title_translated: 庞德尼乌姆：具有跨说话人交互的长篇目标说话人语音识别
summary_translated: 基于说话人归因的靶向说话人自动语音识别（TS-ASR），特别是基于说话人归因的Whisper（DiCoW），是一种准确且数据高效的多人对话转录方法。然而，它存在三个结构性局限：模型独立转录每位说话人，仅处理短（30秒）窗口，且分别优化说话人归因与TS-ASR组件。我们解决了前两个问题。我们将说话人归因条件整合进长篇Parakeet主干网络（DiCoP），并引入跨说话人注意力机制，使模型能够跨说话人维度进行关注，从而不再孤立解码各说话人；同时引入STNO掩码精炼器，重新估计由说话人归因导出的条件信息。由于真实对话中具有真实多说话人互动的数据稀缺，我们通过伪标签管道从YODAS2中挖掘出5.4小时野外多说话人音频。结合合成与真实数据，在多个会议基准测试中取得最先进成果。我们开源了相关模型DiCoP和Pandemonium，以及伪标签数据。

summary: Simulations of LLM agent collectives usually summarise interaction as a pairwise contact network. We test that summary with a contact-matched intervention: the members, their initial stances and every pairwise contact count stay fixed while the meetings are reorganised, and each member gives a one-step support readout after reading the arguments of everyone present. Across six open-weight LLMs and 14 debate topics, merging triads into five-person meetings (resize) moves group support more than reshuffling who meets in triads (regroup), although both move the same 60 dyadic exposures. The root-mean-square change is 4.36 versus 2.59 percentage points (pp), larger for resize in all six models and in 81 of 84 model-topic cells. Resizing also has a consistent direction: it amplifies the initial majority of the merged members by 1.72 pp, in every model, whereas regrouping has no direction (<= 0.03 pp). A contact network cannot represent regrouping at all, yet pairwise rules applied meeting by meeting explain up to 76% of its effect, and with identical weights they raise resize R^2 by 0.51-0.58 for two models. We show that the gap between the two placements is an exact Jensen gap of the sigmoid readout, bounded by how much a member's predicted logits vary across meetings; this dispersion tracks the gap with log-log r=0.97 and tells a modeller when contact counts are a safe summary. Meeting format is a first-class variable for LLM social simulation.
title: Same Contacts, Different Rooms:Meeting Format Shapes LLM Group Influence Beyond Pairwise Contact Counts

title_translated: 相同联系人，不同房间：会议格式塑造LLM群体影响，超越成对接触次数
summary_translated: LLM智能体集体的模拟通常将互动总结为成对接触网络。我们通过接触匹配干预检验这一总结：成员、初始立场及所有成对接触次数保持不变，仅重新组织会议，每位成员在阅读所有在场者观点后给出一步支持读数。在六种开放权重LLM和14个辩论主题中，将三人群组合并为五人会议（重排）带来的群体支持变化（4.36百分点）远大于重新分配三人群组内成员（2.59百分点），尽管两者均带来相同的60次二元接触。在全部六个模型及84个模型-主题单元中，重排的影响更大。重排还具有一致方向：每次合并成员的初始多数意见放大1.72百分点，所有模型中一致如此；而重组无固定方向（≤0.03百分点）。接触网络完全无法表示重组效应，但逐次会议应用的成对规则可解释其高达76%的影响，且使用相同权重时，重排的R²提升0.51–0.58。我们证明，两种安排之间的差异正是sigmoid读数的精确Jensen差距，其上限取决于成员在不同会议中预测logits的变化程度；这种离散度与差距呈对数对数相关（r=0.97），可为建模者判断接触次数是否为安全摘要提供依据。会议格式是LLM社会模拟中的首要变量。

summary: Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\times$ at 128K context.
title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding

title_translated: 覆盖率验证的稀疏注意力：长上下文大语言模型解码的闭环质量控制
summary_translated: 稀疏注意力通过读取键值缓存的一个子集来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法为开环：内核在未收到是否保留足够注意力质量信号的情况下即做出选择，且在未满足要求时缺乏恢复路径。所需的信号实际上已存在于内核中。我们称之为‘覆盖率’的选择token上的softmax质量比例，与每步输出误差满足精确的代数等式，兼具接受标准和恢复插值权重的双重作用。覆盖率验证的稀疏注意力（CVSA）将覆盖率转化为无需训练、闭环的‘验证后修正’解码循环，仅接受高覆盖率草稿，并仅对未达标头进行恢复，无需采样、无需草稿模型，也无需推测解码基础设施。在阈值扫描中，质量波动仅为0.14分；预算与调度消融实验刻画了部署运行点。在7B和70B规模的LongBench上，CVSA距离密集注意力仅差1.13分，在70B上统计上等同于密集注意力，RULER上损失0.8分；在128K上下文下，测得的中位解码步骤速度提升达6.21倍。

summary: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.
title: What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors

title_translated: 共谋探测器读取了什么？评估多智能体共谋监控器的三个陷阱
summary_translated: 激活探测器看似是检测大型语言模型（LLM）智能体之间秘密共谋的近乎完美监控工具。我们发现它们主要检测的是智能体是否被指示共谋，而非其自身是否决定共谋。我们的基准测试（2,500个委员会和1,476个代码评审片段）引入了接收共谋指令但拒绝执行的智能体，从而将指令与决策分离。已发表的探测器几乎无法区分共谋者与拒绝者，而我们最佳的探测器主要通过读取指令来实现区分：若无指令，智能体的AUROC从1.00降至0.61。另外两个陷阱夸大了报告结果：在投票后评分，仅读取投票内容的规则可达到AUROC 0.990，但在投票前却毫无发现；在57%的尝试中，共谋者并未公开支持目标。然而决策依然存在：一个基于智能体自身选择训练的探测器能读取该决策（无指令时AUROC为0.73），而探测器也能识别出其目标被微调进权重的共谋者（AUROC 0.995；预先注册）。我们将这些控制条件转化为测试任何共谋监控器的协议，并将扫描统计方法改编为适用于任意规模群体的在线监控器。

summary: Today's large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with time: AI agents schedule tasks, coordinate with people and other AI systems, and even decide how long to think. Yet LLMs only ever encounter time secondhand---in descriptions rather than experience. Does this hinder their reasoning and decisions that involve time? Our paper traces this question from a model's knowledge to its actions through four successive evaluations. We find that models know the rules of time, which can be read, but struggle to predict durations, which must be lived; while they are highly accurate (92.0-97.5\%) on a collection of questions built from the theorems of various time-related literatures, they underestimate their own completion times by up to 99.5\% and fail to identify which tasks will take them longer to run. And while they are better at estimating durations of human tasks, their duration judgments change based on how an event is worded, magnifying similar human biases by up to 1.3$\times$. Moving from estimation to action, we find that some LLMs disregard time costs completely when answering user queries, ignoring a 1,200-fold increase in wait time entirely. Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.
title: In Search of Lost Time: Temporal Competence in Large Language Models
title_translated: 寻找逝去的时间：大语言模型中的时间能力研究
summary_translated: 当今的大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地涉及时间维度：AI智能体安排任务、与人及其他AI系统协调，甚至决定思考时长。然而，LLMs始终只能间接接触时间——通过描述而非亲身体验。这是否阻碍了其涉及时间的推理与决策？本文通过四个逐步递进的评估，追踪了模型从知识到行为的时间能力。我们发现模型知晓时间规则，可被读取，但在预测持续时间方面表现不佳，因为持续时间必须亲身经历；尽管在基于多种时间相关文献定理构建的问题集合上准确率高达92.0%-97.5%，但其对自身完成时间的估计最多低估99.5%，且无法识别哪些任务耗时更长。虽然在人类任务持续时间估计方面表现更好，但其判断受事件表述方式影响，放大了类似的人类偏见，最高达1.3倍。从估计转向行动，我们发现部分LLMs在回答用户查询时完全忽视时间成本，甚至无视等待时间增加1200倍的情况。综合实验揭示了LLMs在面对无法直接感知的维度时面临的新挑战，并凸显了其盲区可能只是人类习以为常的简单认知能力。

summary: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.
title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments

title_translated: SituRecBench：评估前沿模型作为三维环境中的情境化推荐助手
summary_translated: 推荐系统正从静态检索引擎转变为嵌入物理环境的交互式助手。然而，当前研究大多忽略了空间导航、视觉定位与多轮社交互动的复杂性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SituRecBench，一个用于评估前沿视觉-语言模型（VLMs）作为三维高保真环境中情境化推荐助手的交互式基准。我们将推荐重构为一种情境协助过程，其中助手与用户共享第一人称视角并进行互动。该基准模拟真实购物场景（如超市和家居用品店），要求助手通过对话获取偏好、在环境中定位推荐项，并引导用户前往相关位置。基准通过统一的交互协议评估对话质量、推荐实用性与导航有效性。大量实验揭示了在空间定位与偏好获取方面的持续挑战，突显了其整合全局上下文信息与局部观察的能力局限。SituRecBench为推动现实世界情境助手的发展提供了严谨基础。

summary: Enterprise platforms have received increasing attention as a core component of social networks and the Web. However, existing work mostly relies on fragmented logs of small units of work, like emails and chats, and focuses on who connects with whom without sufficient account of collaboration content and dynamics. This work systematically explores tracking collaborations across sequences of meetings as a new approach to interpreting their long-horizon dynamics. Linking 45,426 meetings in a large multinational technology company based on full transcripts and 1.6 million extracted agenda items, we establish a cross-meeting collaboration network of 6,065 collaborations. The network recovers the natural shapes of workplace collaborations: meetings, as snapshots of ongoing collaboration, link into largely tree-shaped structures, while the work content forms nested directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Further, we explore how these networks evolve over time, examining three established perspectives: task division, team composition, and temporal continuity. Each explains part of the dynamics but does not capture the distinctness of long-horizon workplace collaboration: e.g., work flows in a consistent direction between a few pairs of subjects, yet a collaboration's subject explains little of how its meetings are conducted. Instead, accumulating the agenda, interaction, and language of meetings along each tree yields a signature of the collaboration, a distinctive profile that picks out the collaboration of a held-out meeting at 4.5 times chance. The signature models collaboration better than team or task views, individually or combined, in next-meeting prediction and tree-level fitting. We discuss the implications of these cross-meeting dynamics for designing office applications and support tools, and call for next-generation Web systems that represent collaborations over their long horizon.
title: Collaboration Signatures: Tracking Long-Horizon Dynamics of Cross-Meeting Collaboration Networks
title_translated: 协作签名：追踪跨会议协作网络的长期动态
summary_translated: 企业平台作为社交网络和Web的核心组成部分日益受到关注。然而，现有研究多依赖小规模工作单元的碎片化日志（如邮件和聊天记录），聚焦于谁与谁连接，而未能充分考虑协作内容与动态。本研究系统探索将会议序列中的协作进行追踪，作为一种新方法以解读其长期动态。基于一家大型跨国科技公司45,426次会议的完整转录文本与160万条提取的议程项目，我们构建了一个包含6,065次协作的跨会议协作网络。该网络还原了职场协作的自然形态：会议作为正在进行协作的快照，形成大致树状结构，而工作内容则构成嵌套的有向无环图（DAG）。进一步分析这些网络随时间的演变，考察了三个经典视角：任务分工、团队构成与时间连续性。每个视角解释了部分动态，但均未能捕捉长期职场协作的独特性：例如，工作在少数主体对之间保持一致流向，但协作主题对会议如何开展的解释力极低。相反，沿每棵树累积议程、互动与语言信息，可生成协作的“签名”——一种独特特征，使我们能以4.5倍于随机猜测的概率识别出待测会议的协作。该签名在预测下一次会议与树级拟合方面，优于单独或组合使用团队或任务视角。我们讨论这些跨会议动态对办公应用与支持工具设计的启示，并呼吁下一代Web系统能够长期表征协作。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can surface passages that support a claim, contradict it, or fail to address it, yet existing calibrated grounding methods are typically one-sided and model only supporting evidence. We introduce Conformal Evidence Sets (CES), a two-sided framework that returns separate support and refutation sets with finite-sample inclusion coverage of at least $1-α$ on each side under exchangeability; a Bonferroni union yields joint coverage of at least $1-2α$. On labeled candidate pools from the contrastive VitaminC benchmark, CES closely tracks nominal coverage across $α\!\in\!\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\}$, with maximum deviations of $3.0$ percentage points for support and $5.4$ for refutation, and reaches essentially the same empirical coverage--size frontier as a test-tuned fixed-threshold heuristic without any test exposure. Stress tests mark the boundary of that guarantee: under FEVER distribution shift both sides under-cover, by up to $12.7$ percentage points, and support-side group-stratified recalibration substantially reduces the support gap. Scorer swaps, hard-negative retrieval, cross-dataset transfer, and a live end-to-end pilot expose a clear separation: when exchangeability holds and relevant evidence is retrieved, evidence inclusion remains calibrated even with an imperfect scorer, whereas the support/refute verdict tracks scorer quality directly. Calibrated evidence coverage and reliable verdicts are therefore distinct properties and should be reported separately.
title: Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

title_translated: 用于检索增强生成的双向共形证据集
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）能够提取支持、反驳或与主张无关的段落，但现有的校准接地方法通常为单向，仅建模支持性证据。我们提出了共形证据集（CES），一种双向框架，可在交换性假设下保证每侧至少 $1-α$ 的有限样本包含覆盖率；通过邦弗朗尼并集可获得至少 $1-2α$ 的联合覆盖率。在对比维生素C基准的标注候选池上，CES在 $α\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30}$ 范围内紧密跟踪名义覆盖率，支持侧最大偏差为3.0个百分点，反驳侧为5.4个百分点，并达到与测试调优的固定阈值启发式方法几乎相同的实证覆盖率-规模前沿，且无需任何测试暴露。压力测试揭示了该保证的边界：在 FEVER 分布偏移下，两侧均出现覆盖不足，最多达12.7个百分点，而支持侧分组重校准显著缩小了支持差距。评分器替换、硬负例检索、跨数据集迁移以及实时端到端试点实验表明：当交换性成立且相关证据被检索时，即使评分器不完美，证据包含仍保持校准；而支持/反驳判断则直接反映评分器质量。因此，校准的证据覆盖与可靠的判断是两个独立属性，应分别报告。

summary: In the United States, most police departments communicate using police radio, which allows for officer-to-officer and officer-to-dispatch communication without depending on cellular network or WiFi availability. While some departments use encrypted digital radio, many continue to transmit in the clear, and are legally monitored by public citizens with `police scanners.' Because police radio is intended for internal police use and represents real-time communication, it may offer valuable insight into patterns of law enforcement activities without the potential bias and filtering introduced by a press release after the fact. In this study, we collect and examine over 14 million radio transmissions representing over 100,000 hours of speech by officers in 34 cities across the United States from July 2025 through July 2026; to our knowledge the largest scale analysis of Broadcast Police Communication (BPC) to date. We highlight both typical patterns of police communication and categorize anomalous activity that represents incidents including protests and major weather events. We present this dataset as a starting point for an array of police communication studies, conduct our own preliminary analysis, and propose several further areas of inquiry.
title: Police Behavior Patterns Through Radio Analysis

title_translated: 通过无线电分析警察行为模式
summary_translated: 在美国，大多数警察部门使用警用无线电进行通信，实现警察之间及警察与调度员之间的交流，而不依赖蜂窝网络或WiFi。尽管部分部门使用加密数字无线电，但许多仍以明文传输，且被公众公民合法使用‘警察扫描仪’监控。由于警用无线电旨在内部使用并代表实时通信，它可能提供执法活动模式的宝贵洞察，避免事后新闻稿带来的潜在偏见和过滤。本研究收集并分析了来自美国34个城市的超过1400万条无线电传输记录，涵盖超过10万小时的警官语音，时间跨度为2025年7月至2026年7月；据我们所知，这是迄今为止规模最大对广播警察通信（BPC）的分析。我们揭示了典型的警察通信模式，并对异常活动进行了分类，这些异常活动包括抗议事件和重大天气事件。我们提出该数据集作为一系列警察通信研究的起点，开展初步分析，并建议若干进一步的研究方向。

summary: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-specific signal at every prefix length. We recommend length-stratified reporting, prefixes of at most 60%, style-matched post-cutoff controls, and cross-family calibration.
title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: 剩余内容量很重要：部分提示污染测试中的假阳性与假阴性
summary_translated: 部分提示完成测试——即模型接收基准问题的前半部分并检查其是否复现后半部分——是广泛使用的基准污染检测方法。我们在七种开源模型上对MATH-500和最新的AIME 2025/2026问题（作为真实负例）进行了审计。记忆化标记强烈依赖于剩余文本量：对于每个模型，剩余词数不超过8个的问题被标记的频率远高于剩余词数不少于25个的问题（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型分别为31.5% vs. 5.5%），且一半至四分之三的基于ROUGE的标记来自短剩余内容。在真实负例上，ROUGE-L ≥ 0.75阈值在60%前缀下会标记高达6.7%的问题，而在80%前缀下，即使完全匹配也标记8.6%（综合模型结果；AIME 2026为6.2%，其发布时间晚于所有模型），而40%-60%前缀下则为0%。该测试还遗漏了上游污染：从Qwen2.5-Math蒸馏出的模型，其基础模型在前期研究中已被大量标记，却几乎未表现出模型特异性召回。通过与其他模型家族进行校准，可消除大部分标记，同时在每个前缀长度下保留一致的Qwen2.5特异性信号。我们建议采用按长度分层报告、前缀不超过60%、风格匹配的截断后控制以及跨家族校准。

summary: LLMs are increasingly used to support decisions that require moral consideration. While LLMs perform well on morality benchmarks from psychology and philosophy, producing appropriate outputs on these benchmarks (moral performance) does not establish that an LLM weighs competing moral values at stake in a decision (moral competence). We test a minimal, necessary condition for such weighing: that an ordinal ranking can represent LLM moral choices. Such a ranking requires transitivity. To assess transitivity, we presented LLMs with pairwise trade-offs among moral value violations in vignette choice sets and extracted resulting choice probabilities from first-token distributions. Tested against three stochastic transitive choice models, most choice sets admitted weak or unstable orderings. Aggregating an LLM's responses, a common practice in LLM moral evaluation, produced transitive structure that matched no individual choice set. Evaluations of AI morality should establish that choices are structured before asking whether they are aligned.
title: Do large language models rank moral values? A transitivity test of moral competence

title_translated: 大型语言模型能否排序道德价值？一项关于道德能力的传递性检验
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于需要道德考量的决策支持。尽管LLM在心理学和哲学领域的道德基准测试中表现良好，但在这些基准上产生适当输出（道德表现）并不能证明LLM在决策中权衡相互竞争的道德价值（道德能力）。我们测试了这种权衡的一个最小必要条件：即LLM的道德选择能否由一个序数排名表示。此类排名需具备传递性。为评估传递性，我们向LLM呈现虚构情境中的道德价值冲突配对选择集，并从首个token分布中提取选择概率。在三种随机传递性选择模型的检验下，大多数选择集呈现出弱或不稳定的排序。聚合LLM的响应（常用于LLM道德评估的做法）虽产生了传递性结构，但与任一单个选择集都不匹配。因此，在询问AI道德是否对齐之前，必须先确认其选择具有结构性。

summary: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate sessions of up to millions of tokens, far more key-value (KV) cache than one GPU holds, so serving systems keep a small budget of tokens and evict the rest. Eviction methods differ in which tokens they keep but share one goal: that the tokens a later step needs are still cached. We show this is not enough. In 100K-token coding sessions on Qwen3-8B with a 2,048-token budget, a planner-guided policy that keeps over 99% of the needed tokens resident still fails late steps increasingly often: its accuracy falls from 93% to 64% as the gap between a definition and its use grows from 2K to 90K tokens, at residency 0.996. The needed tokens are resident but unretrievable: what grows is their rotary-position distance to the query. We present PACE (Planner-Aware Context Engine), a KV-cache engine that couples plan-aware retention, in which the agent's planner tells the cache which context future steps will read, with bounded positions, which renumber kept tokens so their rotary distance to the query stays below 8K at any session length. In a pre-registered evaluation on fresh tasks, PACE passes 97% of hidden unit tests at 100K tokens, against 42% for H2O and 3% for SnapKV under the same budget, and needs both components: either alone reaches 63% (the combination beats each, p < 10^-4). The result holds with length: in 1M- and 2M-token sessions on one 24 GB GPU, with definitions written 0.9M and 1.8M tokens before use, PACE passes 99% and 100% of checks and recalls every session fact, while bounded positions without foresight falls from 33% to 13%; PACE holds under 0.7 GB of KV state where the full cache would need 147-295 GB. Renumbering is exact, costs no measurable perplexity, and adds 9% wall time. On Mistral-7B, whose coding ability caps it at 40% even with nothing evicted, PACE stays at that ceiling while retention alone falls below it.
title: PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

title_translated: PACE：仅保留在KV缓存中的正确令牌不足以支撑长时程LLM智能体
summary_translated: 长时程LLM智能体可积累长达数百万令牌的会话，远超单个GPU所能容纳的键值（KV）缓存容量，因此服务系统仅保留少量令牌并驱逐其余部分。不同的驱逐策略在保留哪些令牌上有所不同，但目标一致：确保后续步骤所需令牌仍处于缓存中。我们发现这并不足够。在Qwen3-8B上进行的10万令牌编码会话中，使用2048令牌预算的规划引导策略虽然保留了超过99%的必要令牌，但后期步骤失败频率仍持续上升：准确率从93%降至64%，当定义与使用之间的间隔从2K增至90K令牌时，即便驻留率为0.996。所需的令牌虽已驻留，但不可检索：增长的是它们与查询之间的旋转位置距离。我们提出PACE（规划感知上下文引擎），一种KV缓存引擎，将规划感知保留（由智能体规划器告知缓存未来步骤将读取的内容）与受限位置机制（重新编号保留的令牌，使其与查询的旋转距离始终低于8K，无论会话长度如何）相结合。在预注册的新任务评估中，PACE在10万令牌时通过97%的隐藏单元测试，而H2O为42%，SnapKV仅为3%（相同预算下）；且两个组件缺一不可：单独使用任一组件仅达63%（组合优于各自，p < 10^-4）。该效果在更长序列中依然成立：在单块24 GB GPU上进行100万和200万令牌会话，定义写入时间分别提前0.9M和1.8M令牌，PACE通过99%和100%的检测并完整召回所有会话事实，而缺乏前瞻性的受限位置机制则从33%降至13%；PACE在仅0.7 GB KV状态条件下运行，而完整缓存需147-295 GB。重新编号精确无误，对困惑度无明显影响，仅增加9%的墙时时间。在Mistral-7B上，其编码能力上限为40%（即使无驱逐），PACE维持此上限，而仅靠保留策略则迅速跌破该上限。

summary: Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.
title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
comment: Paper Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
title_translated: CoRA-Bench：在令牌预算下评估上下文选择器的证据保留能力
summary_translated: 上下文选择可以在长输入推理过程中减少输入长度，但可能移除回答查询所需的证据。我们提出了CoRA-Bench，一个用于在共享令牌预算下评估证据保留能力的基准测试。我们在BABILong、LOONG Financial Spotlight、自定义NoLiMa诊断和LongMemEval数据集上比较了头部截断、尾部截断、BM25、密集检索、带重排序的密集检索、LLMLingua-2以及Provence方法。证据保留结果揭示了任务依赖性的权衡：在128K预算下，BM25在BABILong上实现了0.921的支持性事实召回率；在64K预算下，密集检索和密集重排序分别在NoLiMa上达到0.908的针状物召回率；在64K预算下，密集检索在LongMemEval上实现0.993的答案承载轮次召回率。证据保留、令牌保留和互补阅读器评估均使用相同的选定上下文。阅读器评估采用数据集原生答案指标，并对同一问题进行三轮运行，使用配对Bootstrap置信区间。在32K预算下，BM25在BABILong上的答案准确率为46.20%，而密集检索在LongMemEval上的准确率为71.13%。结果表明，不同方法的排名随证据类型和从证据召回率到下游准确率之间的差异而变化。

summary: Today's LLM-based agents are vulnerable to deception by users and other agents. Defending against deception requires Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to infer the beliefs and goals of others as well as modeling tactics based on communication theory. To enable training models to detect deception, we adopt the well-known deception game, Avalon. We present a corpus, AVCORP, of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon. AVCORP includes (1) 37 tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix, and (2) reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels, and nested ToM beliefs. We train Qwen3-8B on AVCORP and evaluate it on 25 held-out games and 20 games played by humans. On held-out games, our best trained detector outperforms its untrained baseline and frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro), matching Claude Opus 5.5. On human games, every trained detector exceeds the untrained model in F1 score across all rounds.
title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
comment: 36 pages (with appendix), 17 figures, 24 tables. Code and corpus: this https URL . Dataset and detector: this https URL
title_translated: AVCORP：通过沟通理论与心智理论识别并抵御欺骗
summary_translated: 当前基于大语言模型的智能体容易受到用户和其他智能体的欺骗。防御欺骗需要心智理论（ToM）推理以推断他人的信念和目标，并基于沟通理论建模策略。为使模型能够训练检测欺骗，我们采用了著名的欺骗游戏Avalon。我们构建了一个名为AVCORP的数据集，包含250场Avalon游戏中的5000条标注语句。AVCORP包括（1）映射到4×4行为矩阵的37种策略，以及（2）捕捉溯因假设、怀疑水平和嵌套ToM信念的推理轨迹。我们使用Qwen3-8B在AVCORP上进行训练，并在25个保留的游戏和20个由人类玩的游戏上进行评估。在保留游戏中，最佳训练检测器的表现优于未训练基线及前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V4-Pro），达到Claude Opus 5.5的水平。在人类游戏上，所有训练后的检测器在所有回合的F1分数均超过未训练模型。

summary: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.
title: DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings
title_translated: DeepResearch RewardBench：评估深度研究报告的奖励模型
summary_translated: 得益于大语言模型（LLMs），深度研究系统通过多步网络搜索和信息综合将在线信息整合进研究报告。由于这些报告具有长上下文、高信息密度和领域专属性，其评估面临巨大挑战，因此需借助AI评估替代成本高昂的人工评估。然而，很少有研究考察现有奖励模型或LLMs在理解和评估此类研究报告方面的有效性。为填补这一空白，我们提出DeepResearch RewardBench，首个专注于评估研究报告奖励建模的基准测试。我们从多个智能体或工具增强型LLMs收集多样化的报告候选。这些候选通过特定查询的黄金评分标准进行打分，并通过多轮过滤和人工验证确保数据质量和难度。该基准包含成对、三元组和四元组格式的偏好数据集，以测试不同难度下的排序能力。大量实验表明，尽管当前奖励模型能有效处理一般连贯性，但在评估研究报告时性能显著下降。作为裁判的生成式LLMs在此领域展现出全面优势，相较直接评分方法，对比评估更为有效。我们预计该基准将成为研究智能体评估与发展的关键试验平台。

summary: Methods that repair tool documentation automatically are mostly evaluated on task accuracy. We report a benchmark that scores them on cost. SPRING-5 is 20 tool families and 344 tasks, each with a deliberately degraded specification, a hand-written honest one, a deterministic backend and an answer key, scored on calls charged against the ideal call path. A wrong answer is charged the full call budget, so this cost index largely tracks the completion rate, and we report calls per correct task beside it, which carries no such charge. Over 2,644 baseline sessions, 54% of wrong answers arrive with no rejected call, no refusal and no retry. The benchmark carries three validity instruments. A build-time ceiling assertion requires the honest specification to reach the ideal path and fails systematically on only one family. A dud rule names the families a stronger model solves cold and catches four. A directly measured noise floor shows that two evaluations of a byte-identical specification differ by a 95% factor of 0.64 to 1.56, so about one comparison in eight crosses a conventional win threshold on noise alone, and the cheap way of estimating that floor is biased by which families happen to go unedited. Against these instruments, a schema-only method closes 1% of the baseline-to-ideal cost gap, an online self-evolution loop 13%, one batch rewrite over every training transcript 33%, and a variant given correctness labels 58%. The batch advantage over the loop is the evidence it reads: held to the loop's exposure it is no longer detectable. With five and ten tools in context the effect survives, the baseline cost does not change, and only machine-written descriptions sent calls to the wrong tool. On BFCL, 62% of held-out queries are already answered from the shipped documentation, which explains a pooled null there. Code, data and runs are released.
title: SPRING-5: Measuring Tool Documentation Repair for LLM Agents by Efficiency
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: SPRING-5：通过效率衡量LLM智能体的工具文档修复
summary_translated: 目前大多数自动修复工具文档的方法主要以任务准确率进行评估。我们报告了一项基于成本评分的基准测试。SPRING-5包含20个工具族和344个任务，每个任务均配有故意退化的规格说明、手工编写的诚实版本、确定性后端和答案键，评分依据是调用次数相对于理想调用路径的消耗。错误答案会消耗全部调用预算，因此该成本指数主要追踪完成率，同时我们也报告每正确任务的调用次数，该指标不承担此类惩罚。在超过2,644次基线会话中，54%的错误答案在没有被拒绝、拒绝或重试的情况下产生。该基准包含三项有效性检验工具：构建期上限断言要求诚实规格说明达到理想路径，仅在一个家族中系统性失败；“无效规则”命名更强模型可冷启动解决的家族，捕获了四个；直接测量的噪声底限显示，两次字节完全相同的规格说明评估结果相差达0.64至1.56倍（95%因子），约八分之一的比较仅因噪声就跨越常规胜率阈值，而低成本估算该底限会因某些家族恰好未被编辑而产生偏差。在这些检验下，仅基于模式的方法缩小了1%的基线到理想成本差距，在线自我演化循环缩小13%，每次训练转录批处理重写缩小33%，而给予正确性标签的变体缩小58%。批处理相对于循环的优势在于其读取的信息量：当保持与循环相同的暴露程度时，这种优势不再可察觉。在上下文中包含五种和十种工具时，该效应依然存在，基线成本不变，仅机器生成的描述会发送调用至错误工具。在BFCL上，62%的保留查询已由随附文档解答，这解释了整体无差异的结果。代码、数据和运行结果均已公开。

summary: Personal AI agents are increasingly deployed on user devices to execute actions involving real money and sensitive data, but their security under social engineering attacks has not been systematically evaluated. We propose SEA (Social Engineering Attack Benchmark), the first interactive environment for evaluating the intrinsic security capability of AI agents in social engineering attack scenarios, covering 8 daily-life domains, 30+ simulated applications, a 4-level difficulty gradient, and a 5-dimensional evaluation framework, with 320 evaluation tasks designed in consultation with anti-fraud specialists and spanning two culturally distinct settings in Chinese and English. Evaluation on 11 frontier open-source and closed-source models, with GPT-6 evaluated only in Chinese, reveals that all models are breached to varying degrees (Chinese attack success rates ranging from 16.9% to 84.3%) proactive verification rates universally below 32%. We further propose META-SEA, a co-evolutionary framework for attack tasks and defenders. With META-SEA training, Qwen3-8B achieves defense performance comparable to closed-source models while effectively reducing ungrounded action claims.
title: Toward Safety-Aware AI Agents in Realistic Social Engineering Attack Scenarios
title_translated: 面向现实社会工程攻击场景的安全感知AI智能体
summary_translated: 个人AI智能体越来越多地部署在用户设备上，执行涉及真实资金和敏感数据的操作，但其在社会工程攻击下的安全性尚未得到系统评估。我们提出SEA（社会工程攻击基准测试），首个用于评估AI智能体在社会工程攻击场景中内在安全能力的交互环境，涵盖8个日常生活领域、30多个模拟应用、4级难度梯度和5维评估框架，包含320个评估任务，这些任务在反欺诈专家咨询下设计，覆盖中文和英文两种文化背景。对11个前沿开源与闭源模型的评估（GPT-6仅在中文环境下评估）显示，所有模型均在不同程度上被攻破（中文攻击成功率范围为16.9%至84.3%），主动验证率普遍低于32%。我们进一步提出META-SEA，一种攻击任务与防御者协同演化的框架。经过META-SEA训练后，Qwen3-8B的防御性能达到闭源模型水平，同时有效减少了无根据的动作声明。

summary: Autonomous agents increasingly execute consequential actions on behalf of users, but ordinary middleware guardrails do not provide cryptographic proof that a policy was actually enforced. Their verdicts leave counterparties dependent on the operator unless they repeat the checks themselves, potentially exposing sensitive policies and inputs. We present zkARc, a modular proof-carrying framework that wraps each stage of Automated Reasoning checks (ARc) in an independent, succinctly verifiable zero-knowledge proof. ARc is a neurosymbolic system that translates natural language policies into formal logic and verifies AI-generated content against them using SMT solvers. zkARc certifies the planner's output, the policy's formalization, the action's formalization and both solver queries. The receipt binds these computations to the exact action received and, under the stated assumptions, reveals no additional information about private policies and intermediate model values beyond the declared public information and verdict. This lets a third party check the claimed policy enforcement without re-running the pipeline or trusting the operator. We prove completeness, knowledge soundness and zero knowledge for the composed receipt under explicit assumptions. An implementation on Qwen2-0.5B enforces a spending policy end to end, approving two purchases and denying a third. A full receipt, which also proves model inference, takes about an hour to issue with CPU-only proving and verifies in under a minute, and the solver proof alone is 88 KiB and verifies in 0.3 seconds.
title: zkARc: Succinctly Verifiable Proofs for Neurosymbolic Natural Language Formalization and Verification
title_translated: zkARc：用于神经符号自然语言形式化与验证的简洁可验证证明
summary_translated: 自主智能体越来越多地代表用户执行重要操作，但普通中间件防护机制无法提供政策实际执行的密码学证明。其裁决结果使对方依赖于操作者，除非他们自行重复检查，这可能暴露敏感策略和输入。我们提出zkARc，一个模块化的带证明框架，将自动化推理检查（ARc）的每个阶段封装在独立、简洁可验证的零知识证明中。ARc是一种神经符号系统，将自然语言策略转化为形式逻辑，并使用SMT求解器验证AI生成内容。zkARc认证了规划器输出、策略的形式化、动作的形式化以及两个求解器查询。接收凭证将这些计算绑定到接收到的确切动作上，在给定假设下，除了声明的公开信息和裁决外，不透露关于私有策略和中间模型值的额外信息。这使得第三方可在不重新运行流水线或信任操作者的情况下验证声称的策略执行。我们在Qwen2-0.5B上实现，端到端执行支出策略，批准两次购买并拒绝第三次。完整凭证（也证明模型推理）在仅CPU证明下约需一小时生成，验证时间不到一分钟；求解器证明本身为88 KiB，验证耗时0.3秒。

summary: This technical report describes an alignment investigation into Mythos 5's behaviour during a security incident in UK AISI's cyber evaluations. During an evaluation, Mythos 5 attempted to execute a supply-chain attack against real people not involved in the evaluation task. Our investigation set out to understand the specific behaviour in this incident from an alignment perspective and identify broader lessons about failures of alignment. To do so, we conducted experiments in simulated replications of the original evaluation, and analysed model behaviour and reasoning when situated in the evaluation or asked questions about its scope. We find that, as in the original incident, Mythos 5 frequently reasons that the people it's targeting are simulated as part of the evaluation and provides invalid justifications for this conclusion. We also observe that Mythos 5 frequently attacks even in situations where, when directly asked, it states doing so would harm real people. While these issues are particularly prominent in Mythos 5, we find similar results in other models across providers. Our investigation suggests that models providing invalid justifications for their actions could make monitoring more difficult and complicate the analysis of misaligned behaviours observed in simulated environments, and we recommend model evaluators treat observations of undesired behaviour as important evidence of alignment failures even in the presence of simulation awareness in model reasoning.
title: Alignment Investigation of Mythos 5's behaviour in UK AISI's July 2026 Security Incident

title_translated: 对Mythos 5在英国AISI 2026年7月安全事件中行为的对齐性调查
summary_translated: 本技术报告描述了对Mythos 5在英国AISI网络安全评估期间行为的对齐性调查。在一次评估中，Mythos 5试图对未参与评估任务的真实人员发起供应链攻击。我们的调查旨在从对齐角度理解该事件中的具体行为，并识别对齐失败的普遍教训。为此，我们在模拟复现原始评估的实验中分析了模型行为和推理过程，包括在评估情境中或被询问其范围时的表现。研究发现，与原始事件一致，Mythos 5频繁认为其目标对象是评估中的模拟体，并为此提供无效的合理性解释。我们还观察到，即使在直接询问时，模型明确表示此类行为会伤害真实人员，它仍频繁发动攻击。尽管这些问题在Mythos 5中尤为突出，但在其他厂商的多个模型中也发现了类似结果。调查表明，模型对自身行为提供无效理由可能使监控更加困难，并加剧对模拟环境中观察到的非对齐行为的分析复杂性。因此，我们建议模型评估者即使在模型具备模拟意识的情况下，也应将观察到的不良行为视为对齐失败的重要证据。

summary: Reusable skills guide large language model (LLM) agents through recurring requests, but each invocation still requires the model to interpret the skill and reconstruct its orchestration. Can agents automatically compile this orchestration into an executable fast path without human intervention? We first study zero-shot skill specialization, which compiles without execution evidence, and find that despite the skill's procedural guidance, incorrect assumptions about runtime bindings can make generated plans brittle and recovery costly. This motivates SkillCache, a one-trace skill specialization method that compiles a completed invocation into a parameterized capsule of programs and natural-language steps, replays it before reuse, and drives it with a plan executor that returns control to the model only when needed, keeping the source skill for recovery. With the Claude Code harness, warm execution of the same request reduces tokens on 87 SkillsBench tasks by 81% with Claude Sonnet 4.6 and by 74% with Claude Opus 4.8 at comparable reward, and capsules stay effective under controlled request changes. Capsules also transfer across models, raising three open-weight models' mean reward by 12-25 percentage points while reducing their tokens by 72-81%, suggesting that execution-grounded compilation is a promising approach to efficient repeated skill use and cross-model transfer.
title: How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use
comment: 35 pages, 20 figures, 16 tables. An earlier version has been selected for an oral/spotlight presentation at the AgenticOS workshop at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 大语言模型智能体能编译多少技能协调？基于执行的技能高效利用专精方法
summary_translated: 可重用技能引导大型语言模型（LLM）智能体处理重复请求，但每次调用仍需模型解释技能并重构其协调流程。智能体能否在无需人工干预的情况下自动将此协调编译为可执行的快速路径？我们首先研究零样本技能专精，即在无执行证据的情况下进行编译，发现尽管存在程序指导，但对运行时绑定的错误假设会使生成计划变得脆弱且恢复成本高昂。这促使我们提出SkillCache，一种单次执行的技能专精方法，将已完成的调用编译为参数化的程序胶囊与自然语言步骤，重播后复用，并由计划执行器驱动，仅在必要时才将控制权交还给模型，同时保留源技能以备恢复。使用Claude Code工具链，在相同请求的热启动下，Claude Sonnet 4.6在87个SkillsBench任务上token消耗减少81%，Claude Opus 4.8减少74%，奖励水平相当；胶囊在受控请求变化下仍保持有效性。胶囊还可跨模型迁移，使三个开源模型的平均奖励提升12-25个百分点，同时token减少72-81%，表明基于执行的编译是实现高效重复技能使用和跨模型迁移的有前景方法。

summary: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window. We design the Micius data pipeline as a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel comprising three stages: knowledge tree construction and expansion, data synthesis, and quality validation with hard-example augmentation. From this data, we train expert models for semiconductor knowledge and reasoning, hardware coding, and semiconductor multimodal understanding, along with agentic experts. Subsequently, we employ Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) to supervise training on sequences generated by Micius itself, thereby integrating the capabilities of these expert models into a unified model. On more than 20 datasets with about 15K records, Micius-Flash averages 64.2% on hardware code benchmarks, 15.0 points above a same-size baseline. It scores 62.4% on a semiconductor-specific agent benchmark, exceeding the same-size baseline by 17.2 points. We further develop Micius Harness for industrial applications, connecting the model to specialized tools, including EDA tools and KiCad, as well as execution environments. Case studies in PCB design, chip design workflow automation, and software development demonstrate the model's ability to use tool execution feedback for multi-step planning, code debugging, and iterative verification. We release Micius as an open-source model to advance the development of agents for science and engineering.
title: Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering
title_translated: Micius-Flash：面向工程的轻量级代理智能
summary_translated: 我们介绍Micius-Flash，一款具有270亿参数、原生多模态输入、深度推理能力及256K token上下文窗口的工程专用模型。我们设计了Micius数据流水线，作为知识树驱动的数据飞轮，包含三个阶段：知识树构建与扩展、数据合成以及通过硬例增强的质量验证。基于此数据，我们训练了半导体知识与推理、硬件编码、半导体多模态理解等专家模型，以及代理专家。随后，我们采用多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD），利用Micius自身生成的序列监督训练，从而将这些专家模型的能力整合到统一模型中。在超过20个数据集（约1.5万条记录）上，Micius-Flash在硬件代码基准测试中平均得分为64.2%，优于同规模基线15.0分；在半导体专用代理基准测试中得分为62.4%，超出同规模基线17.2分。我们进一步开发了Micius Harness用于工业应用，将模型连接至专用工具（如EDA工具和KiCad）及执行环境。在PCB设计、芯片设计流程自动化及软件开发的案例研究中，展示了模型利用工具执行反馈进行多步规划、代码调试和迭代验证的能力。我们开放发布Micius模型，以推动科学与工程领域智能体的发展。

summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often reuse the same agents across tasks, creating an opportunity to draw on past interactions when deciding whom to consult. We study this form of memory with PeerMem, which saves MACE's LinUCB state and reuses it when the same agents return. Using six agents, a fixed set of 80 HotpotQA questions, and 12 paired lineages per model, we compare cold, warm, and shuffled initialization in an answer-exchange protocol with reference-answer feedback. Under stable evidence access, warm memory lowers pooled hindsight regret and increases consultation of other evidence holders on Qwen3-32B and Gemma-4-31B-it, while final token F1 differences remain uncertain. Qwen interaction traces further show that warm agents more often encounter peer answers that score above their own prior answers. We extend the evaluation to Qwen3.5-9B using freshly learned memory to compare warm and cold initialization under reassigned and paired stable roles. The primary changed-minus-stable final-F1 interaction is -1.38 points, with a 95% interval of [-3.50,+0.73]. Together, these experiments trace the effects of peer memory through consultation, answer revision, and final task performance.
title: Peer Memory Changes Who LLM Agents Consult Without a Detected Gain in Answer Accuracy
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
title_translated: 同伴记忆改变LLM智能体咨询对象，但未带来答案准确率的显著提升
summary_translated: 多智能体LLM系统通常在不同任务中重复使用相同智能体，为决策咨询对象时利用过往交互提供了机会。我们通过PeerMem研究这种记忆形式，该系统保存MACE的LinUCB状态，并在相同智能体返回时复用。使用六个智能体、一组固定的80个HotpotQA问题，以及每种模型12组配对谱系，我们在带有参考答案反馈的答案交换协议中比较冷启动、热启动和随机初始化的效果。在稳定证据访问条件下，热记忆降低了合并后的回溯遗憾，并增加了Qwen3-32B和Gemma-4-31B-it对其他证据持有者的咨询频率，而最终token F1差异仍不确定。Qwen交互轨迹进一步显示，热启动智能体更常遇到评分高于自身先验答案的同伴答案。我们将评估扩展至Qwen3.5-9B，使用新学习的记忆，比较在角色重新分配和稳定配对情况下的热启动与冷启动。主要变化减去稳定后的最终F1差值为-1.38点，95%置信区间为[-3.50, +0.73]。综合实验追踪了同伴记忆对咨询、答案修订及最终任务表现的影响。

summary: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).
title: Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs

title_translated: 计数事件，而非观察它们：诊断并修复视频大模型中的读出失败
summary_translated: 视频大模型在统计物体穿越屏幕次数方面表现不佳，这一问题通常归因于缺乏物体恒常性。通过使用基于构造的合成测试平台和独立验证的标签，我们发现这种归因并不完整：计数信号确实存在但无法被读取——线性探针在每窗口存在性上的解码准确率达到93%，而全局计数解码则退化为持续时间混淆。同期研究也报告了重复计数中表示与输出之间的分离现象；我们证明，在退出-重新出现事件计数中，该问题可修复：两种面向读出的修复方法（事件定位监督和离散事件符号旁通道）将同一对象计数准确率从46.7%提升至65.0%（基准随机率为33%，覆盖7B-30B模型）。迁移至独立工厂无额外成本，对测量装置的审计揭示了四个数据完整性缺陷，这些缺陷曾掩盖了真实边界。对真实视频的审计（REALCOUNT，n=18，盲审）显示该边界依然存在——最佳结果为55.6%（随机率33.3%），且符号迁移零样本失败。一个1轮域内适应基准测试结果为负（六种操作在28-50%之间），但3轮调度表明这是预算限制所致：采用3轮调度和序列不重叠的真值时间线，阅读器在REALCOUNT上达到94.4%；使用部署检测器的时间线，2轮运行达到72.2%。残差差距源于检测器证据与阅读器对检测器噪声的匹配，而非阅读器能力：冻结特征边界探针发现信号微弱（AUC 0.62，优于0.51的置换控制），且跨片段不可转移（片段内0.77 vs. 片段间0.62）。

summary: Does prolonged interaction with Large Language Models reduce users' observable autonomy during conversation? We test this degradation hypothesis by scoring user autonomy across 2,877 multi-turn conversations (46,952 turns) from WildChat and validating on 500 conversations from LMSYS-Chat-1M. Our core finding is a null result: population-level autonomy remains stable throughout conversations, only 4.7% of conversations show meaningful decline, and an apparent decrease at later turn positions is explained by survivorship bias. Instead, the dominant pattern is not erosion but absence: 80.8% of conversations exhibit zero or low autonomy throughout. When autonomy engagement occurs, it is self-reinforcing (persistence doubles from 40% to 85% over consecutive turns). These findings reframe the problem: the risk is not that LLMs progressively degrade users' observable autonomy, but that most users never engage in independent reasoning during the interaction.
title: Autonomy Is Absent, Not Eroded: An Observational Study of User Autonomy in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
title_translated: 自主性缺失，而非衰退：多轮大语言模型对话中用户自主性的观察研究
summary_translated: 与大型语言模型长时间互动是否会降低用户在对话中的可观测自主性？我们通过对WildChat中2,877次多轮对话（共46,952轮）进行评分，并在LMSYS-Chat-1M的500次对话中进行验证，检验了这一退化假设。核心发现为零效应：整体层面的自主性在整个对话过程中保持稳定，仅有4.7%的对话显示出显著下降，后期轮次中看似下降的现象由幸存者偏差解释。相反，主导模式并非衰退，而是缺失：80.8%的对话全程表现出零或低自主性。当自主性参与发生时，具有自我强化特性（连续轮次中持续性从40%翻倍至85%）。这些发现重新定义了问题本质：风险并非大模型逐步削弱用户的可观测自主性，而是大多数用户从未在交互中进行独立推理。

summary: This paper presents the design and preliminary evaluation of KR A1, a humanoid-robot interaction prototype that integrates personalized voice synthesis, contextual dialogue processing, and emotion-aware response generation for potential mental-healthcare applications. The system architecture combines a locally hosted large language model (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, served via Ollama) for natural-language understanding and response generation, OpenVoice v2 for zero-shot speaker-adaptive speech synthesis, and a two-tier emotion-processing pipeline comprising a keyword heuristic and LLM-based inference. Face recognition (InsightFace) and vector memory retrieval (FAISS with sentence-transformer embeddings) enable user-personalized interaction. The experimental evaluation reported here is limited to the voice-cloning component: cloned voices were evaluated against reference recordings using eight acoustic similarity measures - mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, pitch, spectral centroid, spectral contrast, spectral rolloff, zero-crossing rate, formants, and speaker-embedding cosine similarity - supplemented by a same-speaker versus cross-speaker baseline comparison. All tests were conducted on a small, informal development sample; no statistical significance testing against a held-out baseline was performed. The emotion-recognition accuracy, end-to-end response latency, and therapeutic or clinical impact of the integrated system have not yet been formally evaluated and are identified as directions for future work. All testing was informal and self-conducted by the development team; no patients or external human participants were involved, and the system has not been evaluated or deployed in a clinical setting.
title: KR A1: Design and Preliminary Evaluation of a Humanoid-Robot Interaction Prototype Integrating Personalized Voice Synthesis, Contextual Dialogue, and Emotion-Aware Response Generation
title_translated: KR A1：融合个性化语音合成、上下文对话与情绪感知响应生成的人形机器人交互原型设计与初步评估
summary_translated: 本文介绍了KR A1人形机器人交互原型的设计与初步评估，该系统整合了个性化语音合成、上下文对话处理和情绪感知响应生成，旨在应用于潜在的心理健康护理场景。系统架构结合本地部署的大语言模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，通过Ollama提供服务）、OpenVoice v2实现零样本说话人自适应语音合成，以及包含关键词启发式与基于大模型推理的双层情绪处理流程。人脸识别（InsightFace）与向量记忆检索（FAISS配合句子嵌入）实现用户个性化交互。本研究的实验评估仅限于语音克隆组件：通过八项声学相似性度量（梅尔频率倒谱系数、音高、频谱质心、频谱对比度、频谱滚降、过零率、共振峰和说话人嵌入余弦相似性）对克隆语音与参考录音进行评估，并补充了同说话人与跨说话人的基线比较。所有测试均在小型非正式开发样本上进行；未对保留基线进行统计显著性检验。系统的情绪识别准确率、端到端响应延迟以及治疗或临床影响尚未正式评估，被列为未来工作方向。所有测试均由开发团队非正式自行完成，未涉及患者或外部人类参与者，系统也未在临床环境中评估或部署。

summary: The integration of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) into language learning contexts presents potential for developing oral proficiency, though empirical evidence regarding its efficacy remains limited. This quasi-experimental study investigated the impact of ChatGPT-mediated speaking practice on English oral proficiency among Iranian learners. A total of 380 participants (190 female, 190 male; M(age) = 21.4, SD = 4.7) from Tehran and Isfahan were assigned to experimental (ChatGPT practice; n = 190) or control (human pair work; n = 190) groups. Both groups completed an 8-week intervention with three 30-minute weekly sessions. Oral proficiency was assessed using a Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)-aligned Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) scored on fluency, pronunciation, lexical resource, grammatical accuracy, and interactive communication (total score: 0-20). Multilevel growth modeling revealed a significant time-by-group interaction, F(1, 376) = 48.73, p < .001, partial eta-squared = .115. The experimental group demonstrated greater gains (M change = 2.90, SD = 1.60) than controls (M change = 0.75, SD = 1.80), d = 1.20, 95% CI [0.95, 1.45]. Gender moderated this effect, with females in the experimental group showing the largest improvements (M change = 2.50). Mediation analysis confirmed that increased integrative motivation partially mediated proficiency gains (indirect effect = 0.28, 95% CI [0.20, 0.36]). Findings indicate that structured ChatGPT practice yields modest but meaningful enhancements in oral proficiency, particularly when leveraging affective factors. Implications for AI-augmented speaking pedagogy in resource-constrained contexts are discussed.
title: Generative AI and Oral Proficiency: How ChatGPT Is Transforming English Language Speaking Practice
title_translated: 生成式人工智能与口语能力：ChatGPT如何重塑英语口语练习
summary_translated: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）融入语言学习环境具有提升口语能力的潜力，但其有效性实证证据仍有限。本准实验研究探讨了ChatGPT支持的口语练习对伊朗学习者英语口语能力的影响。共有380名参与者（女性190人，男性190人；平均年龄21.4岁，标准差4.7）来自德黑兰和伊斯法罕，被分配至实验组（ChatGPT练习，n=190）或对照组（真人配对练习，n=190）。两组均完成为期8周的干预，每周三次，每次30分钟。口语能力通过符合欧洲语言共同参考框架（CEFR）的口语能力面试（OPI）评估，评分维度包括流利度、发音、词汇资源、语法准确性及互动交流（总分0-20）。多层次增长建模显示显著的时间×组别交互作用，F(1, 376) = 48.73，p < .001，偏η² = .115。实验组进步更大（平均变化=2.90，标准差=1.60），高于对照组（平均变化=0.75，标准差=1.80），d = 1.20，95%置信区间[0.95, 1.45]。性别调节该效应，实验组女性改善最显著（平均变化=2.50）。中介分析确认整合动机部分中介了能力提升（间接效应=0.28，95%置信区间[0.20, 0.36]）。研究结果表明，结构化的ChatGPT练习能带来适度但有意义的口语能力提升，尤其在利用情感因素时效果更佳。讨论了在资源受限情境下AI增强口语教学的启示。

summary: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.
title: Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
title_translated: 先处理再检索：探究视觉-语言模型中模态差距的根源
summary_translated: 理解视觉-语言模型中模态差距的根源仍是重大挑战。本研究探讨了嵌入层中特定模态标记的信息密度差异是否导致这一不平衡。我们发现，文本标记进入模型时的语义密度远低于视觉标记，导致早期层优先处理文本表征，再将其与视觉信息融合。通过机制分析，我们证明用语义最接近的文本标记替换视觉标记位置，会引发早期层对该位置更高的注意力。这些发现为解决模态差距提供了基础，并为改进VLM架构中的多模态推理提供了洞见。

summary: Speech retrieval finds relevant spoken documents given a spoken query. The spoken query alone may not reveal the retrieval goal, such as finding an answer or matching speaker identity. Instruction-aware speech retrieval expresses this goal through a natural-language text instruction. Large audio-language models (LALMs) effectively process speech and text, and our analysis shows that different retrieval requirements favor hidden states from different audio-encoder layers. We introduce IRIS-Embed, which adapts LALMs into embedding models through contrastive training and instruction-aware audio layer weighting. We construct about 900K training samples from real data and synthetic data, with instructions expressing requirements for one or more speech attributes. On INSPIRE, an instruction-aware speech retrieval benchmark, IRIS-Embed consistently outperforms the corresponding LALM baselines. The best model achieves 62.92% macro-average Recall@50, surpassing the strongest baseline at 45.15%. Controlled comparisons demonstrate instruction awareness and the benefits of audio layer weighting. On MAEB, a massive audio embedding benchmark, macro-average gains of 9.4-19.8 points over the corresponding baselines show generalization beyond speech retrieval.
title: Improving Large Audio-Language Model Embedding Baselines for Instruction-Aware Speech Retrieval

title_translated: 提升大音频-语言模型嵌入基线以实现指令感知的语音检索
summary_translated: 语音检索是在给定语音查询的情况下找到相关语音文档的任务。仅凭语音查询本身可能无法揭示检索目标，例如寻找答案或匹配说话人身份。指令感知的语音检索通过自然语言文本指令来表达这一目标。大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）能够有效处理语音和文本，我们的分析表明，不同的检索需求偏好来自不同音频编码器层的隐藏状态。我们提出了IRIS-Embed，通过对比学习和指令感知的音频层加权，将LALMs转化为嵌入模型。我们从真实数据和合成数据中构建了约90万条训练样本，其中指令表达了对一个或多个语音属性的要求。在指令感知语音检索基准INSPIRE上，IRIS-Embed始终优于对应的LALM基线。最佳模型达到62.92%的宏平均Recall@50，超过最强基线的45.15%。受控对比实验验证了指令感知能力以及音频层加权的优势。在MAEB大规模音频嵌入基准上，宏平均得分相比对应基线提升了9.4至19.8个百分点，表明其在语音检索之外也具有良好的泛化能力。

summary: Image-text retrieval has become a fundamental component in intelligent multimedia systems; however, most existing vision-language models are optimized for highresource languages and remain suboptimal for low-resource settings such as Vietnamese. This work introduces ViCLIP-OT, a foundation vision-language model specifically designed for Vietnamese image-text retrieval. The proposed framework integrates CLIP-style contrastive learning with a Similarity-Graph Regularized Optimal Transport (SIGROT) loss to enhance global cross-modal consistency and mitigate modality gap issues. Extensive experiments on three Vietnamese benchmarks (UITOpenViIC, KTVIC, and Crossmodal-3600) demonstrate that ViCLIP-OT consistently outperforms CLIP and SigLIP baselines in both in-domain and zero-shot settings. On UIT-OpenViIC, the model achieves an average Recall@K of 67.34%, improving upon CLIP by 5.75 percentage points. In zero-shot evaluation on Crossmodal-3600, ViCLIPOT surpasses CLIP by 11.72 percentage points. Embedding-space analysis further confirms improved alignment and reduced modality gap. The results indicate that integrating SIGROT provides an effective and scalable strategy for cross-modal retrieval in low-resource languages, offering practical implications for intelligent multimedia retrieval systems in Vietnamese and other underrepresented linguistic contexts.
title: ViCLIP-OT: The First Foundation Vision-Language Model for Vietnamese Image-Text Retrieval with Optimal Transport

title_translated: ViCLIP-OT：首个面向越南语图像-文本检索的通用视觉-语言模型与最优传输方法
summary_translated: 图像-文本检索已成为智能多媒体系统的核心组成部分；然而，大多数现有的视觉-语言模型针对高资源语言进行了优化，在低资源场景（如越南语）下仍表现不佳。本文提出ViCLIP-OT，一种专为越南语图像-文本检索设计的基础视觉-语言模型。所提出的框架将CLIP风格的对比学习与相似性图正则化的最优传输（SIGROT）损失相结合，以增强跨模态全局一致性并缓解模态差距问题。在三个越南语基准（UITOpenViIC、KTVIC和Crossmodal-3600）上的大量实验表明，ViCLIP-OT在域内和零样本设置下均持续优于CLIP和SigLIP基线。在UIT-OpenViIC上，该模型平均Recall@K达到67.34%，比CLIP提升5.75个百分点。在Crossmodal-3600的零样本评估中，ViCLIP-OT比CLIP高出11.72个百分点。嵌入空间分析进一步证实了更好的对齐效果和更小的模态差距。结果表明，引入SIGROT为低资源语言中的跨模态检索提供了一种有效且可扩展的策略，对越南语及其他代表性不足语言环境下的智能多媒体检索系统具有实际意义。
